Un vertido tóxico en una nave de carga ha contaminado su carga, y tú, como operador de un dron, debes solucionarlo. Al principio, los contenedores son letales al tacto, pero un disparo rápido con tu pistola descontaminante los neutraliza. Planificación, timing y uso inteligente de la gravedad y los rebotes definen cada intento… porque, pese al título, Don't Panic, el caos está garantizado.

Es un Pac-Man con encanto británico: tú eres el doodlebug, un escarabajo simpático que debe devorar todas las margaritas de un laberinto mientras esquiva insectos depredadores (avispones, escarabajos carnívoros…) que, al tocarte, acaban contigo. Un equilibrio perfecto entre acción, estrategia y ese je ne sais quoi floral que hace del pánico… algo adorable.

meta.name: Doomdark's Revenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.18 KB

The follow-up to the original Lords of Midnight game uses a similar game system to its predecessor, but the story is now much more complex. Luxor the Moonprince's son Morkin has been kidnapped by Shareth, daughter of Doomdark, the evil ruler deposed in the first game. The player initially takes control of Luxor, Rothron the Wise, and Morkin's lover Tarithel the Fey, although many more characters can be recruited as the game progresses, as they aim to banish Shareth and rescue Morkin. Shareth has brainwashed him, so he must also be turned back to Luxor's side.
The game is effectively turn-based; your characters move by day (with a limited amount of movement possible, with each move in one of the 8 compass directions) and Shareth's by night. You will find plains, mountains, forests, underground tunnels and mysterious temples on your journey. A dark mist follows much of the area, which causes your characters to deteriorate in mood and thus become less effective.
The characters are now split into five distinct tribes - Giant, Dwarf, Fey, Icemark and Barbarians, and recruiting new characters into your party isn't automatic - factors such as the game situation can make some refuse to join, turn on members of other races, or defect (as the Utarg did in the first game).
There are several different objectives and possible outcomes to the game. Bringing Morkin back to the Gates of Varenorn is the most basic one, but many other characters ought to be saved, Shareth can be killed completely (with practice!), and there are many Crowns of Icemark to be retrieved. As in the first game, control of the full party only remains while Luxor is alive - his death means total defeat.

En esta aventura en tiempo real eres un prisionero de una cárcel custodiado por droides. Y ya conoces la lista de tareas, algunos de ellos trabajan de día, otros de noche. Otro de ellos como un perro, que está en ritmo todo el tiempo. Pero tienes que encontrar la salida del laberinto usando tus piernas y tu habilidad para derribar las puertas.
Con el tiempo tu salud va empeorando y debes buscar las botellas para recuperarte. Cuando golpeas la puerta, tu resistencia física disminuye y debes encontrar un alimento para restaurarla. En el juego también encontrarás monedas para máquinas dispensadoras de café, pero ten cuidado con los retratos parlantes y otras trampas...

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.76 KB

Doors of Doom (Plus) is very colourful, accompanied by reasonable music, and has a fair degree of strategy and zapalogy involved. Each time you find a piece of the weapon system, you must find out how to use it, then face losing it when you teleport to the next level. Your task is to eliminate all the robots, keeping an eye on your energy level and picking up cups of tea to revive you.
All this would be perfectly hoopy, but  the scrolling  is well jerky (as they say), and your little character seems quite happy to walk through the air in places, as well as on the various bridges, monoliths and girders of the background.
The game's main saving grace is the scenery designer, which allows you to edit the background to your own taste. In fact, the instructions spend more time explaining this option than dealing with the game itself, giving some indication of how exciting the whole business is. Doors of Doom (Plus) - ? I'd hate to see Doors of Doom (Minus).

There are also objects to collect, and watch out for the spiders that will drain your energy.

El Doctor Muerte, presidente de Latveria, planea destruir Nueva York con una bomba atómica robada. Spider-Man y el Capitán América deben unirse —como muestra el cómic incluido— y adentrarse en su fortaleza.

Tras cada fase, viñetas de cómic avanzan la historia y presentan a villanos como el Rinoceronte o Electro. Más que fuerza bruta, triunfa la coordinación: saber cuándo cambiar de héroe marca la diferencia. Un homenaje jugable al espíritu team-up clásico, con ritmo, estilo y doble acción.

You're a pupil at Dr. Scrimes' spook school, and have to show your worthiness by taking a series of tests. It's actually set in his large mansion, where you'll encounter some rather strange guests, such as a hunchback, a werewolf and a mummy. meta.name: Dracula
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 104.33 KB

As the sun sets, Dracula rises, hungry for the blood of fresh victims.  As Dracula, the goal of this game is to stalk the streets at night, feeding on people walking the streets, or by luring them out of their homes.  As Dracula bites his victims, his actions will call the attention of the local constable who will try to slow him down by driving a stake into him.  Dracula can respond by either turning one of his victims into zombies to attack the police, or by transforming into a bat to escape capture.  Even the forces of nature are against the vampire, as wolves will attack him on foot, and hawks will drag away his bat form.  Dracula must feed on a certain number of victims and return to his tomb before sunrise, or he will not survive to feed another night.

meta.name: Dragon Breed
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 81.95 KB

Zambaquous ha hecho todo lo posible para convertir la vida del pueblo de Agamen en un infierno, por lo que su rey Kayus, decide poner fin a esta amenaza.
Lo que diferencia a este juego de todos los demás shoot'em ups de desplazamiento lateral (con la excepción de Saint Dragon) es que montas un dragón, llamado Bahamoot. Tanto tú como el dragón tenéis potencia de fuego, y mantener pulsado el botón de disparo aumenta la ferocidad de los rayos de energía de Bahamoot. La cola del dragón puede controlarse indirectamente y, como es indestructible, puede utilizarse como escudo o como arma.
Hay bonificaciones que recoger mientras desciendes del dragón para recogerlas. Estos incluyen una explosión de fuego, rayos de la cola de Bahamoot, misiles teledirigidos y rayos, con sólo uno activo a la vez. Cada nivel tiene un límite de tiempo.

meta.name: Bad Dudes Vs Dragon Ninja
meta.desc:

DragonNinja, también llamado Bad Dudes Vs. Dragon Ninja, a menudo denominado simplemente Bad Dudes, y conocido en Japón simplemente como DragonNinja (ドラゴンニンジャ?), es un juego de arcade de 1988 desarrollado y publicado por Data East. También se transfirió a muchos sistemas domésticos de computadoras y consolas de juegos. El juego fue seguido por un sucesor espiritual de 1991, Two Crude Dudes (conocido en Japón como Crude Buster). Después de que Data East desapareciera debido a su quiebra en 2003, G-Mode compró los derechos intelectuales del juego de arcade, así como de la mayoría de los demás juegos de Data East, y les concedió la licencia a nivel mundial.
El juego es un beat 'em up de desplazamiento lateral en el que los jugadores asumen el papel del dúo titular encargado de rescatar al "Presidente Ronnie" de los secuestradores ninja. Tuvo un éxito comercial y una recepción crítica generalmente positiva o mixta. Desde entonces, se ha hecho ampliamente conocido por su premisa general y su escena de introducción.

La princesa Alicia del reino de Mitgult ha sido secuestrada por el monstruo Zawell (resucitado por Galda, que quiere conquistar el mundo). Ahora le toca al heroico guerrero Amul transformarse en un dragón azul e ir a rescatar a la princesa.
Dragon Spirit es un shoot-em-up de desplazamiento vertical que consta de nueve niveles. Los jugadores vuelan y destruyen todo lo que encuentran a su paso. La acción se desarrolla en dos niveles, tanto en el cielo como en el suelo. El dragón tiene dos tipos diferentes de ataques: fuego que sale disparado hacia arriba por la pantalla, y fuego que cae para golpear un punto en el suelo delante del dragón. Los enemigos están presentes en el suelo y en el aire.
El jugador puede recoger bonificaciones o mejoras (cabezas extra en el dragón, salud, disparos más rápidos, ...). Hay un jefe al final de cada nivel. Es mejor tener tantas mejoras como sea posible antes de este encuentro.

After Maroc the mage defeated the Lord of Chaos a new power rose, Morog the Shapeshifter Witch Queen of the North. Morog seeks to recover the five crowns of Dragontorc in order to remake the Torc of power. Maroc has to find the remaining crowns and defeat Morag to save the realm.

Estarán los objetos preciados por Erik, custodiados por innumerables peligros.

Implantar mensajes subliminales en música aparentemente funcionó para Judas Priest; el malvado Dr. Blitzen intenta replicarlo insertando mensajes en discos populares. Usa las 8 islas de Arcanium, cada una con una jukebox y un disco que da una pista sobre su fábrica secreta. Dynamite Dan debe explorarlas para detenerlo.
Hay 192 pantallas (24 por isla), con enemigos en patrones fijos: diagonales, perseguidores u horizontales. Todos reducen su energía —hasta la muerte— y algunos le roban objetos. El disco, la jukebox y los enemigos se colocan al azar en cada partida. Dan salta lejos; más si toma impulso.
Objetos recolectables: linterna (evita robos), gafas bomba (abren puertas), comida (restaura energía), batidora (energía infinita) y mancuernas (aumentan salto). Todos se usan automáticamente. Para salir de cada isla, debe encontrar suficiente combustible para su Zeppelin.

Dynamix es un juego de pantalla única donde eres un Controlador Principal de Barras Dinámicas y debes superar tu evaluación anual en un Simulador de Central Eléctrica Dinámica para seguir trabajando en una central real. La pantalla se divide en dos: tú juegas en el lado izquierdo y el ordenador en el derecho. Debes mantener niveladas dos barras dinámicas imitando los movimientos del ordenador a lo largo de varios niveles. En la parte superior hay cinco Activadores Cinéticos de distintos tamaños; el ordenador activa tres antes de que tú puedas empezar. Cuando un activador golpea una barra, esta se mueve una distancia proporcional al tamaño del activador. Debes pulsar tus activadores; cuando las barras estén niveladas, una luz parpadeará en blanco, y si lo hace durante un breve tiempo, se completa la pantalla y pasas al siguiente nivel. Un temporizador retrocede y el nivel debe terminarse antes de que llegue a cero; de lo contrario, es fin del juego y has suspendido.

meta.name: Dynasty Wars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 75.59 KB

Como uno de los cuatro grandes dioses Apolo, Hermes, Hécate y Afrodita, elige un equipo de cuatro poderosos guerreros para que luchen por ti en el torneo Powerplay y demuestre quién es el más grande. Esta batalla se librará sin espadas ni cuchillos, sino con conocimiento: el juego toma la forma de una compleja prueba en un tablero similar al ajedrez.
Tienes cuatro piezas de juego, que comienzan dispuestas como una cruz en una esquina del tablero visto isométricamente. Los cuadrados están divididos en cuatro colores diferentes, cada uno de los cuales representa un área temática amplia y particular al estilo Trivial Pursuit. La pregunta tiene cuatro respuestas posibles, y una respuesta correcta te permite mover tu pieza un espacio, tal vez. Originario de las salas de juegos, Dynasty Wars es un juego de lucha ambientado durante la Era de los Tres Reinos de la historia china, y es, más específicamente, basado en la adaptación al manga de la historia de Tenchi o Kurau. El jugador adopta la identidad de un antiguo guerrero chino, y montando a caballo tiene que eliminar a todos sus oponentes, en su mayoría infantería y arqueros.

As the title suggests, the six races featured are all lengthy, and include two 24-hour races for your two bikes (each with 2 riders assigned to it) to complete. Before each race you must set the bike up, trading off speed, fuel consumption and safety for the engine, and speed, safety and tyre wear for the chassis; you must also choose one of the 3 tire compounds. Races are depicted via a side-view of the bikes scrolling past the pit straight, with constant updates as to the race leader and any bike problems. You can instruct your riders as to how aggressively to race, and  must call your bikes in for pitstops to refuel, change tyres and swap riders. As in the previous game these are controlled in real-time by moving the mechanic around.

meta.desc:

Sury Ani 7 ha sido fuente de recursos mineros durante años, pero ahora, contaminado, su explotación solo es posible de forma remota. Peor aún: su sistema de seguridad, compuesto por droides de defensa, está activo y listo para destruir cualquier intruso.
Tú controlas un Droide de Eliminación Especializado, cuya misión es desactivar el sistema de seguridad y limpiar la zona de material radiactivo. Para ello, debes arrojar dicho material por la escotilla de desecho en cada uno de los 8 niveles, antes de que explote (tiempo limitado). El combustible es escaso y debe buscarse dentro del complejo; el retroimpulso lo consume muy rápidamente. Para acceder al siguiente nivel, deberás encontrar el pase correspondiente.

meta.name: Crazy Er*bert
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.19 KB

The asterisk gives the game away, and a very good version of Q*Bert it is, too. In common with past incarnations of the bouncing creature, 'Er*Bert is a rotund fellow with an unpleasantly large hooter. His only task in life is to bounce around the blocks of various 3D structures, changing their colour as he goes.
Trying to stop him are Boris the gorilla - a smugly jubilant ape - and Coily the snake. For bonus points you can steal Boris's banana, but this is a very dangerous ploy as the hairy beast gets very, very angry. Cascading balls and a black hole appearing at random are other little difficulties 'Er has to overcome.
At the side of the structures are two transporter rings which provide a means of escape back to the starting point and can also be used to lure Coily and Boris to their doom. This game is an excellent Q*Bert clone, with beautiful graphics and good sound.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.00 KB

As a vulcanology researcher on a light aircraft observation mission to the Erebus volcano, you crash in the middle of Antarctica. You find yourself faced with a hostile environment and to make matters worse without any special equipment. A French station houses around thirty researchers and technicians, it is located on the coast. A tribe of birds of all sizes is watching you. It's starting to get very cold... Good luck!!!

meta.name: Escape!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.36 KB

Escape is a RPG-like labyrinth game for medium resolution coded in assembler. 
Your mission is to find the exit of the maze. On your way to the exit you will encounter many obstacles, like bombs, magic traps, teleporters, locked doors and an infinite supply of monsters. Many things in the maze will also aid you in your quest such as bandages, first aid kits, potions, scrolls, money, weapons, rings, belts, wands, and armor. Your inventory may contain up to eight items. 
When you start the game you have no health points so it is very easy to get killed right in the beginning. Your maximum health will increase every time you kill a monster.

meta.name: Escape from Koshima
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.99 KB

You have been held Prisoner Of War by the Japanese for over a year. Relying on the difficulty of escaping through the Burmese Jungle, security at the camp is nominal. Today, there arc only two guards left in the camp, and they are both sleeping in the heat of the afternoon... The object of the game is to escape from the camp and through the jungle. The game starts off in the barrack room. There are just rows of empty beds, an open door through which a soldier can be seen.

meta.name: Espionage
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.94 KB

Espionage is based on the board game of the same name. Up to four players (either human or computer-controlled) compete to become Master Spy by returning all the micro film canisters back to their base. A player has 12 agents in their team including secret agents, surveillance agents and courier agents. Each type of agent moves around the board in a different way, not unlike in chess. Besides getting the micro film, another objective is to terminate any enemy agents. This is done as in draughts, by jumping over the agent into a free space. Killing enemy agents nets points, which, combined with points for recovered film canisters and surviving agents are tallied for the final score.
The board is viewed from above. It does not fit the screen all at once, so scrolling is necessary. The game offers a hint function (indicating what the computer thinks is the best move to take) as well as the option to show the last move made. The game ends through an (optional and adjustable) time limit or when all film canisters have been retrieved.

meta.name: European Champions
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.23 KB

European Champions is a managerial football game where you select from one of 32 European National teams and attempt to qualify for the European Championships before trying to win the tournament. After choosing your team you presented with a number of options that allow you to see your fixtures, squad, tables, medical and other options. You are also able to select friendly games in between your qualifying matches. Once you have looked at various options you then go on to your first game. You are able to pick your team with five subs and a formation, as well as playing defensive or attacking, and choosing a passing game. The match itself shows the whole pitch with the scoreboard on the right hand side. You watch the ball move around the pitch with major incidents are shown by text. The game speed is selected before the match (1-10) and you can choose one of your subs at any time of the match.

meta.name: European Superleague
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 52.06 KB

European Superleague is a managerial soccer simulation which is about an fictional European league featuring eight of the most successful teams (PSV Eindhoven, Glasgow Rangers, Liverpool, Arsenal, Real Madrid, Olympique de Marseilles, AC Milan and Bayern Munich). The player takes control over one of those clubs and is responsible for its athletic and financial success. The player has all the usual options available, including tactics, lineup, transfer market or training. A speciality is the weekly board meeting in which the chairman gives his opinion on the team's current stand. Each team has 20 athletes with abilities which influence their performance during the match (no graphical representation). The game is completely menu-based and the sub-menus are reached through the main menu which has a different graphical or text presentation depending on the used platform.

meta.name: European II : The European Cup
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.20 KB

European 2 is a football management game in which the player takes on the European Cup in its old form as a pure knock-out competition. There are seven skill levels, which determine the quality of the player's team - alternatively each player's abilities specifically can be typed in.
Before each match the player is shown each team's Goal Scoring Ability, which gives them some idea of how a match is likely to unfold. Full European rules on disciplinary points are included, as are away goals and penalty shoot-outs to decide ties which are level after the 2 matches.

meta.name: Evasion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 56.65 KB

Escape plunges you into the border town of Syldavia, fresh out of prison. Your goal: reach your companions beyond the borders while managing 15 HP and 15 Strength points. The city, spread over 100 tiles, is filled with diverse locations — streets, subway, docks, park, and town hall — and characters with unpredictable intentions. Every encounter turns into a strategic choice: flee, fight, beg, or try your luck at the Morra mini-game. Items — passport, compass, boat, sail — can help your escape or prove to be traps. The game's standout feature is its modular design, allowing players to expand the adventure using the BASIC listing, blending adventure gameplay with a sandbox narrative. Escape delivers a rare sense of freedom and inventiveness, an audacious title that remains compelling even today.

meta.name: Evening Star
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.86 KB

Evening Star is basically an enhanced Southern Belle - a steam engine simulator - with the route changed to early 1960s Somerset and Dorset line (from Bath to Bournemouth, England) and the locomotive being BR standard class 9F (2-10-0) "Evening Star" (number 92220, the last British steam engine built) hauling the "Pines Express".
The game has a demonstration mode and seven scenarios of increased difficulty with the highest level allowing you full control of the train, with all the gauges to watch, more problems that arise and a random timetable to follow. You start at a standstill in the station and must get your train moving. Different levels of speed must be maintained on the track to keep with the speed limits that are placed on the track and keep an eye on the signals that you will see on the way. The correct use of the whistle must be used and you have to make sure your water, steam and coal levels are correct to make sure you keep to the timetable.
The game is viewed from a first person perspective with you in the cab of the train with all the levers and gauges in front of you. You are able to see into the distance in front of you and the sides. As well as the main playing area you can also see your speed, water and coal level, any signals, gradient (slope) indicator and the time.

meta.name: Every Second Counts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 72.45 KB

Every Second Counts is a computer game based on the popular UK television show of the 1980's. This is a quiz show game for either 3 couples or 6 individuals, single players compete with a computer partner, where contestants compete to win seconds, not points. The player with the most seconds takes part in the final round where those seconds are the time they have available to compete. There are 6 blocks of questions so the game can be played 6 times before some categories come up a second time. The team with the greatest number of seconds competes in the final round. The team chooses 1 of 2 categories of question. They take turns in answering a series of 6 questions within their time limit. If all questions are answered correctly then they team is presented with a further set of 7 questions which they attempt to answer within the remaining time. At the end of the final round the team's score is displayed on the Every Second Counts trophy screen.

meta.name: Everyone's a Wally
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.23 KB

Everyone's a Wally fue la primera aventura arcade con múltiples personajes jugables: empiezas con Wally (albañil), pero puedes cambiar a Wilma (su mujer), Tom (mecánico), Dick (fontanero) y Harry (electricista) —nombres inspirados en la expresión Tom, Dick and Harry. Su bebé Herbert aparece como obstáculo móvil.
No se cambia libremente: debes encontrar al personaje para controlarlo. Los no activos se mueven por el mapa con IA sencilla —novedad en su época—. Cada uno tiene vidas y «resistencia» propias; si cualquiera muere, se acaba la partida.
El objetivo es completar una tarea diaria por personaje (Wally construye un muro, Wilma devuelve libros, etc.). Al terminar, obtienes una letra. Las cinco forman la contraseña «BREAK», necesaria para abrir la caja fuerte con los sueldos. Las letras son visibles antes, pero deben recogerse para activar la apertura.

meta.name: Evil Donjon

Un hechicero llamado Elric ha lanzado un malvado hechizo sobre el reino de Sir Frondebeuf. La única forma de restaurar la normalidad es recolectar varios frascos que se encuentran en la Torre del Mal (o Donjón del Mal si eres francés). Es un sencillo juego de plataformas donde debes recoger los frascos en cada nivel mientras evitas a los monstruos. Estos siempre intentan acorralarte, pero tras unos intentos puedes aprender a usar esto a tu favor.

meta.name: Exploding Wall
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.09 KB

Exploding Wall está inspirado en el arcade Arkanoid: controlas una paleta en la parte inferior y rebotas una pelota hacia arriba para eliminar todos los ladrillos y pasar de nivel. La diferencia con otros juegos del género es que no es de pantalla única: puedes rebotar la pelota a izquierda o derecha, y al mover la paleta en esa dirección, la pantalla se desplaza. Debajo del área de juego hay un radar que muestra la posición de los ladrillos restantes. Al destruirlos, algunos sueltan bonificaciones: láseres, misiles o ralentizan la pelota. También hay alienígenas que se mueven por la pantalla y se eliminan al golpearlos. Si la pelota pasa la paleta, pierdes una de tres vidas.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.56 KB

meta.name: Fallout
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.22 KB

A devastating nuclear war had wiped out almost the entire population of the Earth. The civilization, as we know it, has been destroyed. The Earth has become a huge wasteland populated by mutated creatures. Only small number of humans survived and they formed communities living on the surface, where they mostly scavenge what remains from the pre-war civilization. Some lucky people managed to reach safety of the Vaults, huge underground dwellings, during the war. Recently, the water purification controller chip in Vault 13 broke. Without clean water, the people of the Vault cannot survive. One person is sent to find a replacement chip and ventures outside to face a dangerous world, hoping to return within a hundred and fifty days.
Fallout is a role-playing game that utilizes a character development system called S.P.E.C.I.A.L., an acronym formed from the first letters of the game's basic character attributes: Strength, Perception, Endurance, Charisma, Intelligence, Agility and Luck. In addition to having these attributes, the protagonist can also learn and improve skills, as well as acquire traits and perks. 
Skill points are awarded when the player character levels up; traits are assigned during character creation, while perks are obtained every three character levels. There are eighteen different skills in the game, divided into combat, active, and passive categories. Combat skills include weapon proficiencies (e.g. small and big guns, melee, etc.); active skills are used for support or interacting with the environment (doctor, lockpick, science, steal, and others); passive skills are mainly dedicated to social interaction (barter, speech, gambling, and so on). Traits bestow various benefits upon the character while also imposing penalties; in contrast, perks are purely beneficial. By developing and customizing attributes, skills, traits and perks, the player is granted a considerable freedom in shaping the protagonist in his combat-related and social behavior. 
The game has an open world which can be freely explored from the onset. Only a few quests are required to complete in order to advance the main plot; a vast amount of side quests is available. Thanks to the game's emphasis on social interaction, many problems can be solved in a non-violent way; in fact, it is possible to complete the game without engaging in battles at all, running away from enemy encounters and concluding the final confrontation in a relatively peaceful fashion. Conversely, the player can opt for a destructive path, killing everyone in sight. A Karma system is used to track the player's moral decisions during the game.
Combat in Fallout is turn-based. Participants have a limited amount of action points (AP) per turn; each action (including movement) depletes a certain number of AP, eventually ending a character's turn. The player can target specific body parts of enemies during battles. Characters may join the protagonist, traveling together and participating in combat as a party. Though the player may assign general commands to the companions, their actions are controlled by the AI, and they cannot be customized.

It's up to a band of heroes to restore order and defeat the forces of darkness. Fer & Flamme is a party-based RPG, with rules heavily inspired by Dungeons & Dragons (character classes and levels, races, monsters). The player creates a party of five characters, distributing points between 4 traits (strength, intelligence, dexterity, wisdom) and choosing spells and equipment and sets out to explore Thulynte. The game uses a system of icons for player input. The display switches between an overland map for travel, a first-person view when exploring cities, and a top-down tactical view for combat. Fer & Flamme was huge for an Amstrad game, with a 40000 squares map and cities with more than 120 different locations, using all the space available on both sides of two floppies. A PC port was started by UBI Soft but abandoned when the main developer quit.

meta.name: Flight Path 737
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.48 KB

Flight Path 737 is a flight simulator or as the cover says an "advanced pilot trainer". The player is the pilot of a jet airliner and his task is to take of from an airport, climb over the mountains that surrounds it and then land safely on an airfield in the valleys below. The player only gets one chance as there is only enough fuel for one landing. The game is played from a first person perspective and the screen is split into two parts: a landscape view at the top and the instrument panel below. The instrument panel shows all the information that is needed such as altitude, speed and artificial horizon. The game can be played on six different skill levels. Each level adds more complexity to the task. On the first level the mountains are 5000 ft. high and the runway is three miles long but for each level the mountains get higher and the runway gets shorter. On the most difficult level the mountains are 9200 ft. and the runway is only 1.5 miles. Each level also adds more tasks that have to be taken care. On level 2 the engine can catch fire, while level 3 require smoother landing. Level 4 to 6 add crosswinds and require reverse thrust when landing.

meta.name: Football Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.21 KB

The football management game style has been one of the most enduring since Kevin Toms pioneered it in 1982. You start in the 4th division with the team of your choice, and can play on indefinitely in the hope of reaching the top division and dominating it, as well as winning the cups. Players can be bought or sold, with their transfer values varying according to the size of any bid. Their skills and morale vary as the season goes on, with resting key players in easy matches often a key move. You can take out a loan, limited depending on your division, while day-to-day bills must be covered. Matches feature short animated highlights sequences of key moments (Text only for C16).

Football Manager 3 is a managerial simulation in which the player is responsible for the athletic success of a soccer team in Great Britain. The game is controlled via menus which are reached by clicking on graphics in a visualized office. The focus lies on the athletic aspect, e.g. tactics, training (can be set separately for each athlete ) or lineup, the financial aspect is mostly restricted to buying and selling athletes on the transfer market. Of course each athlete has a number of statistics associated which influence his performance on the field. The matches are shown in one of two two non-scrolling perspectives, either top-down or slightly angled from the side, on which relatively small player icons do their work.

Las secuencias de acción implican estudiar un plan de movimiento en la pizarra y luego colocarse en la posición correcta para ejecutar el tiro final. Si no marca suficientes goles, puede perder su lugar en el equipo; Hazlo especialmente bien y es posible que consigas un ascenso en la liga.

In Nightmare Park the player must try to escape the park. There are several paths for the player to walk, but each is subject to various random events. The player starts with three lives and can lose lives in the random events or when accidentally departing from the path.
Random events usually involve twitch game play, such as dodging stampeding unicorns, moving towards the on-screen exit before a time limit is reached, solving a sum within a time limit, or memorizing a word that's only shown a fraction of a second on the screen.
When the player loses a life he or she can continue on the spot where the life was lost, but when all lives are lost the player has to start over.

meta.name: Formula One
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.96 KB

Shortly after Football Manager became a sensation, the sports management concept was applied to the high-pressure dollar-intensive world of Formula 1 racing. The top six teams of the early 80s are featured (Ferrari, Williams, Renault and McLaren as well as the now-defunct Brabham and Lotus), and you can choose which one to manage. Your first tasks are to choose your two sponsors and two drivers, with all the day's top names as well as 6 'rookie' drivers, who are cheap, but there's no guarantee of getting a good one.
Once the game is properly underway, you must buy engine and chassis upgrades, and can improve the quality of your pitcrew - all of which eats into your budget. Your cars must be raceworthy to be able to race. After qualifying you must choose your tyres for each car - rain can be a factor, and the game informs you of the expected conditions before the race.
The races are depicted via a timing board which displays the top 6 in the order, images of the cars flashing by (with a distinction made as cars come into the pits), and messages detailing crashes, spins and technical problems. Your drivers can be called in for pitstops, which involves moving a man around to undo each tyre in sequence, which is hardly realistic but does add some arcade skill and variation.

meta.name: Fortune en Mer du Nord
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.68 KB

North Sea Bullion Adventure casts the player as the the captain of the salvage tug boat "Narwal". You are on the hunt for a wrecked World War II vessel the HMS Bearheart. The ship went down in arctic waters and is rumored to have held valuable cargo. Take to the high seas on your mission to find and retrieve its cargo.
The game provides instructions on-screen and uses a text parser for keyboard input with a total of twenty unique commands to choose from. Find the shipwreck and retrieve the sunken cargo before running out of fuel, oxygen, or time. The game, while rather unclear, has no proper ending but instead allows the user to decide when to finish. This ambiguity may lead to confusion for players who did not read the instruction manual.

Pepe Rebotes was carrying out a study on the black legends of medieval castles. Following the trail of the ghost castle he ended up in a lost valley in Transylvania. Finally he could go down in history. One more step and he would be the first to step on the damp, ancient slabs of the best kept secret in history. But, a trap door opens and... How would he get out of the pit where he had fallen? Your mission is to get Pepe out of the pit where he is. To do this you will go up through the dungeons of the castle until you can get out. Pepe moves from left to right and jumps.

meta.desc:

You control a helicopter and have to collect all the fruits. There are 8 tables. But beware! You must not run into spiders or killer hoops. To make things worse, deadly flowers have been added as well as invisible traps that swallow you when you pass over them. From the 4th table, enemy helicopters will chase you. You control your helicopter using the game controller. In each table, you are entitled to 6 laser shots which allow you to make your way through the jungle. But beware! In each table (except the first), each shot has a specific use. So, don't waste your shots unnecessarily otherwise you won't be able to reach the end of the course. The number of shots remaining is represented at the bottom of the screen by 0s (six initially). You shoot using the button on the controller.

meta.name: Frank Bruno's Boxing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 55.29 KB

Former boxing World Champion Frank Bruno, famed for his catchphrase "you know what I mean, Harry?" and more recently his heroic battle with depression, put his name  to this boxing game which replicates Punch-Out. As Frank, you must take on 8 progressively tough boxers to win the title.  
The action is viewed from right behind Frank in 3D, meaning that you can see and feel the full impact of punches. A full range of moves is provided, with the standard jabs complimented by body punches and the ability to dodge, duck or raise your guard.
Each punch weakens your opponent's strength, although going long enough without being hit can see this begin to recover. A rain of blows can produce a quick knockout, but in general you must hit him many times, and then with a knockout blow, to see him go down.

El Sr. Stein desea construir monstruos, usando los huesos repartidos por su mansión. Cada vez debe recoger las partes necesarias, en el orden correcto, desplazándose por las plataformas. Solo puede saltar sobre superficies elásticas; otras características del terreno incluyen hielo y baba (que afectan al movimiento) y postes de bombero. Enemigos con trayectorias predefinidas incluyen arañas, tanques y langostas.
Una vez conectadas todas las partes, Frank debe activar el interruptor en la caja del monstruo. Esto lleva a una pantalla donde debes alcanzar la esquina superior derecha, evitando las bolas que el monstruo lanza hacia abajo y que ruedan por las plataformas.

meta.name: Frankenstein
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 103.42 KB

The story in the game starts with the player taking the role of Dr Frankenstein. Having pursued your research for many years you have acquired the necessary body parts and assembled them to create a perfect being. However what rises from the slab is horrible and you ran from the laboratory in fear and disgust. On your return you find that the creature has left so you breathe a sigh of relief and move on to other things.
Four years pass and word reaches you that your sister has been slain, strangled by some hideous monster. Your task is clear, you must track down this monster, for you have no doubt where it came from, and destroy it.

meta.name: Frankenstein Jnr.
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.20 KB

Players take control of the son of Frankenstein's monster, and are tasked with the objective to rebuild his dad. Franky Jr. needs to search the castle for his father's body parts so that they can be rejoined back together. This will allow Franky Jr. to reanimate his father's body by jolting it back to life with 10,000 volts of electricity. Franky Jr. can also collect keys to open certain doors. Ghosts and skeletons will try to stop him by draining his energy which will eventually lead to a cardiac arrest if his energy gets too low.
The game is a flick-screen maze game. One room is seen at a time. The joystick moves Franky Jr. while the fire button allows him to pick up objects. The screen also shows his energy, his heartbeat, and any objects he has picked up.

meta.name: Frankie Crashed on Jupiter
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.88 KB

Frankie Crashed on Jupiter is an English-language, text / graphic adventure. A certain spaceship called Frankie crashed landing on Jupiter. If it were not Jupiter, you could still call that "normal," but Jupiter is a gas giant. But then what you have to gather together in the spaceship and build in order to get a codeword falls under "slightly off the hook". Curious? Just play through, then you know it too ...

meta.name: Frankie Goes to Hollywood
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.81 KB

Playing a thoroughly drab, mundane and predictable character, your aim is to become interesting enough to reach the Pleasuredome. After discovering a gruesome murder, your interest in something greater than the routine of 80s Liverpool is awoken.
You explore the streets and houses in the search of a way out. The main basis of the game involves picking up objects and using them in the correct way - most objects have more than one potential use, and misusing them is the only way the game can be lost. There are several sub-games along the way, including shoot 'em ups, a maze and a jigsaw puzzle.

Freedom: Rebels In The Darkness is a game that combines elements of strategy, stealth and fighting games. The main character is a rebellious black slave working on a sugar plantation that tries to incite a revolt among the slave population to gain freedom and to give comeuppance to each of their old masters. At the start of the game there is four characters to choose, each with different statistics and abilities like "constitution" and "lock-picking". The main game screen is a map of the plantation, where you guide a small icon of the character while trying to avoid the guard dogs. If the dogs find you, they either bark and alert the owners or attack you. When they do, the screen switches to a first-person screen where you have to avoid being bitten and killed by the animal.

Para llegar a ella, debes atravesar terrenos variados y peligrosos: selvas, desiertos, matorrales y rocas ralentizan tu avance, y cada zona tiene numerosos soldados y tanques enemigos intentando detenerte. El jugador sólo tiene tres vidas y muchos jugadores encontraron este juego extremadamente difícil si no completamente imposible después de sólo unas pocas pantallas, sin embargo, el juego se puede completar. Hay aproximadamente 50 pantallas diferentes y al vencer a la última ola de enemigos, el juego vuelve directamente a la pantalla No.1.

Galaxia is an arcade style shooter. You control a spaceship and need to earn as many points as possible by shooting the various enemies that appear on the screen. Unlike many similar games (such as Demon Attack or Phoenix) your ship can move about the entire screen and is not limited to horizontal only movement. On each level has there is a timer; if time runs out and you haven't finished destroying all of the enemies, the next level will begin, however all of the remaining enemies from the previous level will remain on the screen (so you now have two sets of enemies to destroy at once). There are many different types of enemies to destroy which become faster and more numerous as the levels progress.

Creado en la época dorada del hardware de escalado de sprites de SEGA (After Burner, Out Run) en arcades, Galaxy Force combina After Burner y G-Loc R-360, ambientado en el espacio.
El juego se divide en cuatro «escenas» o planetas: el mundo A es un planeta verde; el B, un planeta de lava y fuego; el C, un planeta acuático verde; y el D, un planeta helado y árido. Debes pilotar tu nave sobre la superficie, enfrentando no solo oleadas de enemigos al estilo Space Harrier, sino también fenómenos naturales: meteoritos, erupciones de lava y tornados. Para combatirlos, dispones de una Vulcan y un stock ilimitado de misiles.
Tras cruzar el planeta, entras en un sistema de túneles en su interior. Al girar el túnel, se indican las maniobras necesarias, pero su estrechez deja poco margen para evadir. Al salir, el planeta entero se destruye, llevándote al enfrentamiento final contra el jefe supremo.

Tras un día fructífero dedicado a su hobby favorito (comer, ¿qué más?), Garfield se duerme junto a la nevera abierta de Jon. El frío lo sumerge en un sueño: los Alpes suizos, la mayor fábrica de lasaña del mundo y un pollo mítico que pone huevos de chocolate. El jugador debe lograr que el sueño termine feliz antes de que despierte.
Garfield: Winter's Tail incluye tres minijuegos:
1.- Esquí alpino hacia una rampa que lo lanza al techo de la fábrica de lasaña.
2.- En la fábrica de chocolate, Garfield debe garantizar que las gallinas mecánicas reciban su suministro de chocolate por tuberías.
3.- Patinaje sobre un lago helado, siguiendo huellas de chocolate dejadas por el pollo.
Odie aparece constantemente: roba comida que Garfield necesita para recuperar energía, manipula controles de ascensores en la fábrica y sierra agujeros en el hielo.
Los tres minijuegos se pueden jugar en cualquier orden, pero solo completándolos en secuencia (esquí → fábrica → lago) se desbloquea el final.

Gary Linekers Superskills es un partido de fútbol con un enfoque original: ¡se trata sólo de entrenar! El jugador debe resolver una secuencia de minijuegos en un tiempo limitado (general). Los minijuegos se dividen en tres categorías básicas: gimnasio (machacar botones), malabarismo con la pelota (usar movimientos en el momento adecuado) y evento de campo. Este último también se divide en tres disciplinas sucesivas: regatear obstáculos, penaltis y golpear el balón a través de neumáticos suspendidos.
Es importante controlar el pulso del deportista y su nivel de energía, que puede recuperarse descansando o bebiendo. El juego hace esto automáticamente por el jugador si las estadísticas bajan demasiado, pero lleva más tiempo. El juego ofrece tres niveles de dificultad que se pueden asignar por separado para cada participante.

Much of the design and programming of Superstar Ice Hockey (by many of the same programmers) is revised to provide a six-a-side soccer game. You can control any combination of centre-forward, goalkeeper (on the C64) and manager. For much of the game you are merely the centre-forward as the action unfolds around you - don't be afraid to track back and help out. 
The ball sticks closely to a player, who can pass, shoot, head or bicycle-kick it. Goalkeepers are penalised for retaining possession for too long (a rule later adapted for use in real-life football). Match length can be between 6 and 90 minutes, by toggling the speed at which time moves. Fouls are fully implemented.
Single matches can be played in the cassette version, but the disk version adds a full-season structure. 64 English teams are split into 4 divisions of 16, with a season consisting of either 7 or 15 matches.

meta.name: Gazza II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.82 KB

In the game inspired by legendary English footballer Paul 'Gazza' Gascoigne, you play matches with your favourite international team.. Moving in eight directions on a side-scrolling pitch, you also can control the power of your kick. Teams you choose are different in difficulty - Brazil is more powerful team then Albania. But you can't play in Premier League or a knockout championship. Two human players can play against each other, although only one can use a joystick on some versions.

meta.name: Gazza's Super Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.43 KB

This was the first of the two football games licensed around Paul Gascoigne, then the most expensive player in British football history. The game is viewed top down, and can be set to either move left-right or top-bottom.
League and cup tournaments are included, as are single matches and set-piece practice sections (you have full control of these). The gameplay involves a number of advanced moves, and includes a gauge to control the exact dimensions of a kick (height and curl as well as strength), if you can use it quickly enough. Unusually, you have control over the goalkeeper, so can only blame yourself when you concede a goal. The players each have their own skills and strengths, and these develop as the game goes on – if you play well, your players become better, and more capable of facing better opposition.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.81 KB

Este es el juego de baloncesto para computadora que empieza donde los demás se quedan. Porque este juego se basa en el trabajo en equipo. Elige a tu compañero de equipo de una lista de diez jugadores cuyos estilos se inspiran en auténticas superestrellas profesionales. Entrena con juegos como "Around the World" y "HORSE", o juega un uno contra uno con un amigo. Pon a tu equipo en forma para la liga. Y llega hasta la final del Campeonato GBA. Juegas a GBA BASKETBALL en una cancha completa. Y a la hora de lanzar, tienes un amplio abanico de opciones. Como ganchos, rebotes ofensivos, tiros en suspensión... e incluso volcados.

meta.name: Gemini Wing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 88.56 KB

Humanos y alienígenas viven en armonía en el futuro, hasta que un periodista de prensa sensacionalista siembra odio hacia los alienígenas. Estos responden invadiendo el planeta, y depende de ti resolver una situación inquietantemente similar a la realidad en esta conversión de arcade.
Gemini Wing es un shoot 'em up con desplazamiento vertical, que se distingue por su inusual sistema de potenciadores: en lugar de obtener tokens ocasionales que mejoran permanentemente el armamento, aparecen ráfagas ocasionales de tokens que garantizan un breve estallido de fuego mejorado. Los fondos orgánicos son detallados y tienen múltiples secciones que disparan contra ti.

meta.name: Gems of Stradus
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.49 KB

You move around a maze of rooms, picking up objects and treasure while avoiding the nasties.  You can move about by using the cursor keys, as in an arcade game, but all other actions require text adventure type commands.
Each location is accompanied by a fairly basic drawing, though as they are mostly all rooms very little changes between places.  The ultimate aim is to find the treasure room and nab all the goodies.

meta.name: Geoff Capes Strongman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.12 KB

En una época donde las simulaciones deportivas multi-evento estaban de moda, Martech lanzó una licenciada por un exitoso lanzador de peso y fuerte. Ofrece seis eventos que representan tareas típicas de hombre fuerte: tirar de camiones, tira y afloja y lucha libre. Cada uno debe completarse en un límite de tiempo; se otorgan puntos según el tiempo restante.
El método de control y filosofía del diseño distingue entre los 8 músculos principales que Geoff usa. Tras un desafío de mover el joystick para generar la máxima fuerza, eliges a qué músculos asignarla, añadiendo estrategia y prueba de memoria.
Durante cada evento, los 8 músculos aparecen a ambos lados de la pantalla; cuando uno se usa, parpadea. Controlas un cursor para clicar en él lo más rápido posible y lograr el máximo efecto. La energía no usada en cada músculo se guarda para eventos futuros.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 55.60 KB

Crafton & Xunk es un juego de acción y aventura en el que controlas a Crafton, un androide que busca escapar del centro de investigación en el que está prisionero. Para hacerlo, tienes que juntar los 8 pedazos de código que le permiten abrir la puerta de salida tras localizar los 8 científicos que los poseen. También debes prestar atención a los enemigos que surcan las diferentes localizaciones del complejo.

meta.name: Get Dexter 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 95.79 KB

En esta secuela de Get Dexter, el androide Dexter y su ayudante Scooter regresan. Dexter debe viajar al planeta Kef para ayudar a los Swapi, cuyas buenas relaciones con los Stiffien se han roto tras el surgimiento de una secta entre estos. El secreto está en el edificio Antines, pero antes debe ganarse su confianza superando tres tareas.
Es una aventura de acción isométrica: explora salas, resuelve puzles e interactúa con personajes. Puedes recoger y usar muchos objetos; las tres misiones son abordables en cualquier orden, pero solo tras completarlas se abre el acceso a Antines.
En Kef viven tres especies: los Swapi (amistosos, con quienes comerciar), los Stiffien y animales hostiles, que deben evitarse o eliminarse con trampas, dinamita o láser. El contacto reduce la batería de Dexter: si se agota, pierdes, aunque puedes recargar enchufándote. Scooter, ahora más útil, acude al ser llamado y recoge cualquier objeto al que señales.

meta.name: GFL Championship Football
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.54 KB

This must be one of the earliest team sport games to use a first-person view ? the packaging mocks the Xs and Os used to represent players in contemporary Gridiron games. What you see is what the player sees ? control and viewpoint passes from the kicker to the receiver on a punt or kickoff, and the quarterback to the running back or receiver on a pass or kick. Releasing passes involves rotating the controls to select the pass direction. To take the ball, aim the visible hands in the centre of the screen.
There are 28 teams split into four divisions; their names are fictional (including the Seagulls, Mustangs and Geronimos), and each is rated out of 3 on 8 areas of skill. Matches last for 4 quarters of either 4 or 7 minutes' in-play time. Menus to select plays or teams involve using diagonal movements for selection. 
Standard Gridiron rules apply gain 10 yards in 4 attempts (downs) without fumbling or having a pass intercepted; kick a punt or field goal if you are about to fail at this.

meta.name: Genghis Khan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.49 KB

Genghis Khan es básicamente un juego de estrategia, pero no sólo. Una parte muy importante de tu habilidad como gobernador dependerá de tu experiencia arcade a la hora de conquistar los territorios que rodean Mongolia. Tu misión será invadir el Imperio Chino, y para ello deberás derribar la Gran Muralla utilizando pólvora.
Lamentablemente no estará disponible desde el principio, por lo que tendrás que conquistar Bagdad donde se guardan los secretos de la fabricación de pólvora, para luego dedicar tu tarea a destruir la barrera que te impide la victoria. Pero no será tan fácil, también tendrás que derrotar a varios enemigos de diversa dificultad.
El juego te hace elegir entre arcade, estrategia o una mezcla de ambos. En la primera categoría deberás utilizar el joystick para derrotar al dueño del terreno elegido. La pantalla se convierte en un juego de desplazamiento lateral en el que un guerrero mongol, espada en mano, debe enfrentarse a las hordas enemigas. Cada soldado que mates equivale a cinco en total, y cada golpe que recibas supondrá la pérdida de cinco unidades tuyas.

meta.name: Ghost Hunters
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.71 KB

Hunk Studbuckle debe adentrarse en la Mansión Pesadilla para rescatar a su hermano Chuck, desaparecido hace tres días tras intentar expulsar a sus fantasmas y espectros.
Armado con el Sub-Compact Anti-Matter Phantom Splatterer, Hunk lucha contra las fuerzas del mal. Al entrar en una habitación, su Terrómetro sube y su Energía Macho disminuye: debe destruir los espíritus o salir antes de agotarse. Las pociones mágicas reparten energía perdida.
Ghost Hunters es un platformer de pantallas fijas. Con mando, mueves a Hunk; manteniendo pulsado el disparo, controlas la mira del arma. En modo dos jugadores, el primero maneja a Hunk y el segundo, la mira. En pantalla también aparecen la barra de Energía Macho, el Terrómetro y la puntuación.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.43 KB

Basado en la película del mismo nombre, los Cazafantasmas es a quienes hay que llamar para acabar con cualquier plaga de fantasmas. Utilizan mochilas de protones y trampas en las que capturan a los fantasmas y los transfieren a una unidad de almacenamiento. La amenaza se extiende por todo Nueva York, y los Cazafantasmas deben reducir los niveles de actividad paranormal (PK) de la ciudad, que representa el poder de los fantasmas, antes de que se despierte la malvada diosa Gozerel en el Templo de Zuul.

meta.name: Ghostbusters II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.25 KB

Ghostbusters II sigue la trama de la película, en la que el Fantasma de Vigo pretende apoderarse de la Tierra habitando el cuerpo de Oscar Barrett, el joven hijo de Dana Barrett. El jugador controla al equipo de los Cazafantasmas mientras intentan detener a Vigo. El juego presenta tres niveles diferentes basados ​​en escenas de la película. En el primer nivel, Ray desciende a un túnel del metro para recolectar baba mientras intenta ahuyentar a los fantasmas. El jugador debe intentar recolectar el limo antes de que su "coraje" caiga a 0 cuando los fantasmas intenten atacarlo. El segundo nivel es un shoot 'em up con la Estatua de la Libertad caminando por Broadway en Nueva York. El jugador usa la antorcha encendida de la estatua para disparar bolas de fuego a los fantasmas que se aproximan. En el nivel final, los Cazafantasmas deben intentar deslizarse de forma segura por una cuerda para aterrizar en el museo de arte antes de rescatar a Oscar y derrotar a Vigo.

Ghouls es un juego de plataformas de una sola pantalla donde controlas una criatura para recuperar las joyas de poder robadas por fantasmas y guardadas en una mansión embrujada.
Desde la parte inferior de la pantalla, salta y camina por plataformas hasta las joyas en la parte superior; algunas sueltas se pueden recoger por el camino.
Hay fantasmas, arañas, púas, plataformas móviles y caídas peligrosas: tocarlos te quita una de 4 vidas. Recoge una joya especial para hacer desaparecer a los fantasmas unos segundos, o muelles para saltar más alto. Completa el nivel antes de que el temporizador llegue a cero o pierdes una vida.

meta.name: Gilbert : Escape from Drill
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.32 KB

Gilbert: Escape from Drill is an action game based on the animation series Gilbert. Gilbert, a disgusting alien, has come home after finishing shooting his current TV series. He needs to leave the planet Drill soon because he needs to sign his next contract - but unfortunately the population of Drill are sick of Gilebrt's arrogance. So they stole important parts of his space ship and hid them in town. 
The town is a maze-like structure where various enemies try to harm Gilbert, but by using his snot he can oppose them. Killing enough enemies on the same screen cause a power up to appear which can be saved for later (up to four) and has positive effects on Gilbert, e.g floating. The most important part of the town are arcade machines which lead to mini games. After beating a high score (failing to win causes a penalty to the time limit), a part of the space ship is placed in town and Gilbert gets a hint where it can be found. 
The machines are:
Brain Drain: Memory
Sprout Wars is a shooter
Greed: Collecting bags in the correct order, but without crossing the own path
Snot Fight: Skeet shooting

Goblin Towers is a text based treasure hunting adventure. 
A large and ancient castle stands in a large and ancient wood. It is rumored that within the castle live goblins who guard a vast treasure. 
The player starts their quest in the forest, outside an abandoned cottage that the local villagers maintain and treat as a kind of shrine. After exploring the cottage the player must explore the woods until they find the castle. Once inside they must continue their exploration until they have found the treasure and escaped.
In the classic tradition of text based adventures, points are awarded as the player makes progress through the game. The maximum possible score is 160.
The game loads in three parts, it is entirely text based and keyboard controlled. The player progresses through the game by issuing commands such as "Go North". The parser allows complex sentences such as "Put the red apple into bucket", and if more than one bucket is present it expects the player to specify which by entering"Put the red apple into metal bucket".

meta.name: Golden Path
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 66.78 KB

Y'n Hsi is a Buddhist monk whose father was murdered by a warlord called Ch'un Kuei. In order to defeat the tyrant and regain his family's palace, he must tread the golden path, the road to transcendence.
The Golden Path is a point and click adventure game. Instead of using verbs like in Maniac Mansion, the player controls the monk with the mouse by moving a cursor shaped like a Chinese letter and clicking directly at him on the screen. Left-clicking on a spot on the ground moves the monk towards it. Left-clicking below Y'n Hsi makes him bend over to drop or pick objects on the ground. Left-clicking above his head makes him try to use the object he is holding at the moment (if it is not possible to do so, a question mark appears). Right-clicking makes him punch and kick, his defense against enemies. Every time the monk is hit, the inventory briefly flashes. A book sits at the bottom-left of the screen, and serves as a hint system of sorts. When clicking on it, a message about the screen appears with explanations to events, characters and objects. Besides the book is the inventory with four slots for objects. Left-clicking on an object places it on Y'n Hsi hands. Above the inventory is a slowly withering vine as the energy bar. It grows with the completion of certain tasks. 
The main objective is to follow the golden path. Literally. On the bottom-right of the screen there is a small version of the main game screen that shows the path and its bifurcations. The character moves from screen to screen collecting things laying around, fighting the occasional enemy and using the right object at the right place.
Pressing S saves the game, while typing L loads it.

meta.name: Goldrush
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.83 KB

In Gold Rush!, Jerrod Wilson (the player character) receives a letter from his long-lost brother (who fled the city years before when was hastily accused and convicted of a crime he didn't commit) asking him to join in Sacramento, California. If that's not enough for Jerrod sell everything and give his hometown Brooklyn a fond adieu, under the stamp was one of the first nuggets of Californian gold seen in the Atlantic shores of the United States. So, Jerrod bids farewell to his peaceful life as a newspaper editor, and becomes a fore-runner in the the great Gold Rush of 1849, hoping to find his brother and "strike gold" (literally).
Released late into the lifespan of Sierra's AGI engine, Gold Rush! features some tricks not seen before the more advanced SCI engine, such as enlarged characters, but it is best known for the three routes available to reach California: by land, travel by boat to reach the Atlantic shore of Panama, cross the isthmus, and then get a second boat in the Pacific shore, or making the dangerous all-boat trip by Cape Horn. Each route has its dangers: Cholera might strike as you make your way across the Northern states or your boat might sink. As usual with Sierra adventures, instant killing happens if the player is careless, but will also happen at random. Other important (and innovative) concept is the game being timed. If Jerrod takes too long to leave Brooklyn, passages to California increase in price, and his house devalues.

meta.name: Grange Hill
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 26.02 KB

Grange Hill was a British children's TV show that ran from 1978 to 2008 and was based in a fictional comprehensive school in North London. The game is an arcade adventure with elements of a graphic text adventure and sees you take the role of two of the characters from that period in the mid 80s, Luke 'Gonch' Gardner and his best friend Paul 'Hollo' Holloway. Gonch has had his Walkman confiscated at school which was then stolen from the staffroom. You and Hollo have to sneak back into the school and attempt to find it before midnight or you will face punishment from your Mother when you return home. You need to collect and use objects in their correct locations as well as interact with other characters.
The main playing area is viewed from the side and is flick-screen where you control Gonch as you interact with your surroundings and other characters. You are also able to jump over obstacles and if you touch any then it is game over. Below the main playing area is text which describes your current location, any objects found, and shows you any conversions you are having. Press the fire button and this brings up a menu which alllows you to pick up, drop, examine, use, give, take and talk. A clock in the corner counts towards midnight and you are also able to see objects you are carrying.

meta.name: Gravity
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.27 KB

In a nuclear facility, The player now controls a particle that didn't manage to leave the chambers after split. Now you have to explore the corridors and find the exit to merge the particle with its parent atom. The exit is only passable if all 42 caves have been visited. Unfortunately the walls are electrically charged. Avoid them to keep your 8 lives. Gravity fields start from box-like structures and direct the player in a specific direction. There are also flashing barriers, switches that open barriers, power outage, and a labyrinth that stretches across several pictures. There is a time limit of 100 units. Touching other particles that you come across brings 25 new units of time. Game is controlled with the cursor keys. A total of 4 speed levels can be achieved by pressing longer or several times. If you press the SPACE key, the particle stops immediately but with a time penalty. If you hold down the SPACE key, you can still move the particle (with the cursor keys) and the effect of the fields is canceled (usefull for precise controls).Good luck.

Using the same game engine and structure as Level 9's game of The Secret Diary of Adrian Mole, the book's follow-up was recreated on computer. The game is an adventure of sorts, presenting you with 18 months of life viewed through the curious, confused and intellectual eyes of Adrian. Each section features a number of challenges, in which one of three choices on what to do must be made. As you play, the aim is to make Adrian as popular as possible by making the correct choices so as to exert a positive impression on Mum, Dad, Pandora, Nigel, Bert and all the rest. The game is split into four sections, which can be loaded individually or in sequence, with the score remaining in memory as you progress through them.

South-Western Pacific, August 1942. US Marines capture the strategically important island in the first American amphibious assault of World War 2, but the battle of Guadalcanal will rage on for the next six months, as the Japanese will try to re-capture it.
The player is given the command of air, land and naval forces, including aircraft carriers and transport ships (supply is crucial as well as intelligence - patrol seaplanes and scouts are available). meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 94.92 KB

Guardians is a puzzle game in which the player takes the role of a guardian who is tasked with containing the so-called "Triffids", balls of pure energy. The game is played in a top-down perspective and has two plains. The upper plane is where the player is active and has to build walls. There are blocks of five colours which can be freely moved over the area. If multiple blocks of the same colour come together, they fuse together and are no longer mobile; those fusions are called "cohesions".  Some blocks can be combined with any colour. The player can both use blocks which are already on the plain and place bricks from a reservoir. 
One to three triffids are on the lower plain and bounce up and down. If they bounce up and there is block hindering them, they are lost and give minus points. Regular blocks are destroyed when they come into contact; only cohesions are a permanent wall. The goal of each level is get a certain amount of points (by creating cohesions) within a time limit.

- A first-class petty officer who serves as boat captain and pilot

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.33 KB

The goal of this two-player game is to shoot as many ducks as possible and retrieve them with the help of your dog to score a higher score than your opponent. You and your opponent control a hunter and a dog. When the hunter aims at a duck, press the fire button to shoot the duck with one of the barrels of the shotgun. But if you miss, press the fire button again to fire with the other barrel. Steer your dog to retrieve the duck with the use of your joystick and place the duck in the basket at the hunter's feet. Ducks can fall on land or in the water. The difficulty for the dogs to retrieve the ducks changes. This is also the reason for the different number of points awarded;
    Duck falls on land – 10 points.
    Duck falls in water – 40 points.
    Duck falls on the island – 100 points.
The difficulty level increases with;
    Floating tree trunks: The dog has to dodge them.
    Fish: They can bite and drive the dog into the river. You then will need a new dog.
    When swimming the river be careful of the current or you will be swept away
In level 4 you get a new obstacle; a fox will sometimes appear and steal a duck from the basket. You can chase him away with your dog, but if a duck is stolen, you lose 10 points.

The first thing the player/players of Gutter must do is inserting credits, using them to access the ball. In turns, each of you have to guide a ball down a gutter surrounded by a patchwork 3D effect. This is done by steering it left and right to give it angular acceleration.

As such, hitting monks can be a good move if you are confident. On the right of the screen you may see your career progress in the gutter (D/1/2/3/0/S).

Barry también puede morir si es tocado por Dennis.

meta.name: Gyroscope
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.36 KB

Releasing a game which resembles a well-known arcade game before any official license can be released was always a challenge for publishers, and in this case Melbourne House released a game similar to Marble Madness. Controlling a gyroscope, you most navigate your way down a sloping track full of hazards. The viewpoint is in fixed isometric 3D, with hazards including buildings, ramps and drops. The gyroscope accelerates quickly and takes time to slow down, so it is easy to go into a screen too fast.
Failing to keep the gyroscope spinning freely as it navigates these costs you one of your seven lives. You are also playing within a time limit - losing a life sees you return to the start of a level without regaining lost time, but running out of time sees you lose a life, but be able to continue from where you were left with a new set of time (so, as with Chase HQ, completing tricky levels can take 2 or 3 lives at first). 
You get time bonuses for completing a screen, points bonuses for completing one of the seven four-screen levels, and an extra life for reaching 1000 points.
At the end of level 7, you will get 1000 points for each remaining lives, doubling your current amount of lives. You will then start again at level 1 but mirrored by the vertical axis (you are now climbing from the bottom of screen to the top).
After level 14 (level 7 mirror), you will again win 1000 points for each remaining lives and then the game loop on level 1 (not mirrored).

meta.name: Hacker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.55 KB

Hacker is an adventure/trading game based on what was then a unique idea. You're starting into the adventure as a real hacker would do, lacking information of what is to come, only driven by your ambition. Consequently, the game opens with a plain text screen, prompting you for the login password. To break into the system is the first puzzle you've got to solve.
Once in, you'll soon find out that you've accidentally stumbled upon a conspiracy of global impact. From then on, you'll maneuver a robotic drone around the globe through a tunnel system deep in the earth. In major cities, you may surface and talk to contact persons, who'll trade items for cash. When delivered to the correct city, you can exchange these items for a piece of evidence. If all evidence is collected, you're to inform the FBI. As if figuring out the correct routes and trades wasn't hard enough, frequent system malfunctions and security checks test your skill as well...

meta.name: Halls of Gold
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.74 KB

Corredor de maratón y minero de larga distancia: ese es el triste destino que Ariolasoft te ha preparado en Amstrad. El rey Aquantus, muy amado, recibió monumentos funerarios subterráneos laberínticos, repletos del oro del próspero reino. Hoy lo siguen amando las momias, que matan sin piedad a quien perturbe la paz de los muertos.
Debes correr, subir escaleras, saltar entre niveles, evitar vagonetas usadas para extraer mármol y colocar bombas como trampas para perseguidores. La más mínima indecisión es fatal. Tras alcanzar —¡al fin!— la puerta salvadora que cruje al abrirse… ¿salvado? ¡No! En las siguientes 24 escenas, las trampas se multiplican: suelos podridos que ceden, oro tentador que no se puede recoger (y no da puntos), caídas directas al nivel de las momias.
El disquete incluye una segunda serie de 24 niveles, más difíciles, y permite a los jugadores crear y guardar sus propios diseños —¿para probar con amigos?

Un pasillo largo con siete puertas a la entrada te ofrece la oportunidad de acceder a las áreas de mazmorras de dificultad variable (más fácil y más abierto en la parte superior, más difícil en la parte inferior). En estas áreas de la torre puedes explorar, encontrar tesoros y botellas de elixir (que se pueden utilizar para reponer la magia del jugador). Las Cosas deambulan por los distintos corredores y te persiguen y atacan, llegando incluso a disfrazarse de objetos ordinarios hasta que te tengan a tiro. Afortunadamente, dispones de una espada y un arco, así como hechizos mágicos, para defenderte y autocurarte. ¿Será suficiente para hacerte con el botín o las Cosas te llevarán a la perdición?

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 57.22 KB

You are the rightful heir to the throne of Hamil - stolen away as a young child, you had grown up unaware of your birthright.  To you, the kingdom of Hamil was known only through myths and rumors: a place of magic and grandeur, steeped in legends of majestic castles and wondrous antiquities; but also fraught with danger, as creatures and powers of the dark side have taken a particular shine to it.  Finally learning the secret of your identity, you decide to ride out to Hamil and stake your claim.
However, there are hidden powers who would like very much to have Hamil for themselves, and they don't think too highly of your endeavor.  As soon as you set out they follow in hot pursuit, and finally force you to take refuge in a small run-down chapel at the edge of the kingdom.  Here the adventure begins, as your first task is to find a way out of your makeshift sanctuary without snuffing it rather quickly.

Igual número de objetos lanzados que penetren nos harán perder una vida.

meta.name: Hard Drivin'
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 62.76 KB

Hard Drivin' es un éxito arcade en 3D de Atari Games. Estás al mando de un coche deportivo de altas prestaciones. Tu objetivo es correr por el recorrido lo más rápido posible y alcanzar tantos puntos de control como sea posible. Si llegas a un punto de control, ganas tiempo extra para llegar más lejos. Verá tráfico en la carretera tanto en su dirección como en la dirección opuesta, así que tenga cuidado al pasar...
El recorrido tiene dos secciones: pista de velocidad y pista de acrobacias. La pista de velocidad es más larga, pero normalmente se pueden alcanzar velocidades más altas. La pista de acrobacias requiere que realices varias acrobacias, como saltar puentes, conducir a través de un circuito, etc.
Chocar el auto no tiene consecuencias graves y, de hecho, muestra una repetición del accidente desde un ángulo cinematográfico. Admira tu choque de frente contra el camión de cemento, o el choque con la minivan, o el vuelo desde el puente en el ángulo equivocado... Pierdes varios segundos mientras tu auto se "reinicia" y recuperas la velocidad nuevamente.
Las conversiones caseras conservan la mayoría de los gráficos 3D avanzados de entonces, pero carecen de la retroalimentación de fuerza que había en la versión arcade.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.56 KB

Hard Hat Mack es un juego de plataformas similar en concepto a Donkey Kong. El jugador controla a un obrero que debe completar objetivos específicos en una obra, evitando enemigos y sin agotar el tiempo. El juego tiene tres niveles verticales con caminos simples, trampolines, cintas transportadoras y ascensores. Los objetivos incluyen: reparar agujeros en el suelo, atrapar un martillo neumático móvil para fijar placas, recoger fiambreras y arrojar mercancías a un procesador. El protagonista pierde una vida si lo golpean pernos que caen, o lo tocan vándalos u inspectores de la OSHA. El juego termina tras perder tres vidas. Al completar los tres niveles únicos, se reinicia desde el principio, repitiéndolos con mayor velocidad.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 67.07 KB

The game tries to represent the 1st Harricana Snowmobile Race, which took place in Québec (Canada) in 1990 and patterned after the infamous Paris-Dakar rally. There are eleven stages with different visible horizons: Québec - Lac-Édouard - Saint-Gédéon Roberval - Lac Chigoubiche - Chibougamau - Rivière Broadback - Nemaska - Eastmain - Chisasibi - Poste-de-la-Baleine - Lac Wawa - Radisson.
Controlling  the snowmobile in third-person behind view, the player should ride through a path marked with yellow flags in snow woods. Accelerating the snowmobile to move it forth and back is possible to avoid its blocking either by trees or debris in the snow. The direction of the way is shown also by the compass. When the way is lost, the player should find it as fast as possible. Other racers are present on the way during the day and night, and the last place on the stage means the end of game. So, the player should conquer the snows of Québec, show good time on each stage, and to be the first at the finish.

meta.desc:
