Heathrow International Air Traffic Control faithfully simulates the job of a radar operator at two major international airports: London Heathrow and Schiphol Amsterdam. The objective is to safely land ten aircraft or more within a time limit of 30 minutes. The task is broken down into a number of selectable levels to allow the player to gradually develop his or her skills. The player must radio instructions to approaching planes, keeping them separated and avoiding collisions. If planes get too close, there is a collision risk warning. Too many warnings or actual collisions will fail the level.

meta.name: Heavy Metal
Heavy On The Magick
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.90 KB

With full graphics throughout, Heavy on the Magick aimed the standard adventure style at a wider audience. Axil the Able is stuck in Collodon's pile, and he must find a way out. At the start, the game will randomly generate his Skill, Stamina and Luck - you can regenerate these if you don't like the initial values. As you play your experience statistic will increase.
The graphics are created in memory before being copied onto the screen; this causes some pixellated areas, but there's a full examine option with some helpful hints as to the item's benefit/risk.
The lair is on many levels, and most rooms have multiple exits across the 8 compass directions. Vampires and Werewolves are among the many creatures which guard the corridors - you use magic to kill or freeze these, although some can be beaten back by possessing certain objects.

meta.name: Helichopper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.16 KB

Your people's clones are trapped behind an electric fence on each of the 23 levels of this action game. To rescue them you must pull up next to the fence and wait for them to cross, before placing them into one of the gaps on the left of the screen. The correct one to place the clone into cycles through in sequence. On each level a set number of these must be rescued.
The difficulty is that a swamp lies between the fence and the safety zone, and it is constantly spawning creatures who kill you on contact. You are armed with bombs with kill in a direct downward trajectory, so will be using the top area of the screen a lot. Although you can slot into one of the home-cells and wait for the sequence to cycle round, this runs the risk of becoming trapped in the section as the swamp-creatures encroach. The colour of the swamp things dictates the score but not the difficulty. On later levels there are static hazards on screen, as well as enemies firing at you.

meta.name: Chopper Squad
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.49 KB

Chopper Squad (Helicómpero 2000) se basa libremente en el exitoso Jetpac de Spectrum. Tienes el control de un helicóptero y debes volar por la pantalla recogiendo pedazos de un avión. Una vez que tengas una pieza de la nave, debes llevarla a la parte inferior derecha de la pantalla. Hay cuatro tipos de extraterrestres con los que lidiar. A medida que avanzas construyendo aviones, los extraterrestres comienzan a acercarse a ti y el juego se vuelve más difícil. Para ayudarte en la tarea, has sido equipado con un láser de disparo rápido con el que puedes enviar a los extraterrestres
Chopper Squad es un juego razonablemente divertido, pero los gráficos y el sonido son tan pobres que se vuelve aburrido rápidamente.

meta.desc:

Marble Madness meets pinball. Ball rolling game with a simple goal: Move the ball to hit moving targets within time limit to win the level.
On the higher levels feature hazards and bonus items, and you can score some big points if you hit them in the right sequence. Most targets are cutesy-looking aliens, and a big yellow arrow shows which one you must bounce at next.

Herbert's Dummy Run es el cuarto de cinco juegos de la serie Wally Week (Automania, Pyjamarama, Everyone's a Wally y Three Weeks in Paradise). Muestra al bebé Herbert perdido en unos grandes almacenes, intentando encontrar a sus padres, Wally y Wilma, en la Oficina de Objetos Perdidos antes del final del día. Como en juegos anteriores, es una aventura arcade: debes recoger objetos y colocarlos en lugares correctos. In this beat 'em up game you control Hercules, the illegitimate son of Zeus and the mortal woman Alcmene. Hera, Zeus' wife, therefore hates Hercules and made him kill his two children. 
The King of Argos gives him 12 labours that he has to fulfill.
These twelve labours are symbolized by icons that appear occasionally on the screen. You have to collect these labours while fighting off skeletons that carry swords.  The fights take place in ancient Greek temples amongst other places.
If you hit a labour it will put into an urn but a spider tries to steal the labours from you. Kill it with a well placed blow.
If all twelve labours have been collected he must face the the end boss of the game, the mighty Minotaur.

Heritage is an arcade adventure game inspired by Artefakt Przodków, released back in 1992 for Atari 8-bit platform. As a space pilot sent on a dangerous mission, the player must visit an asteroid - former shelter of mad Myriadians scientists - to recover their inventions preserved on disks containing scientific data. As the spacecraft was destroyed during landing on the planet, the mission is complicated by the necessity of finding the spare parts.
There are many useful objects scattered around the space base and its surroundings. The pilot may carry two items at a time. Same limit applies also in each location, where only two things may be dropped on the ground. Apart from using items the player may read notes and use Jetpack with unlimited fuel, especially needed to avoid robots and other hostile creatures.

meta.name: Hero of the Golden Talisman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.50 KB

The town of the game's hero is under a curse from an evil wizard. He has stolen the Golden Talisman that had protected the city in the past. Broken into five pieces, the Talisman is hidden in a labyrinth filled with monsters. Now the hero has to find all five pieces of the Talisman and destroy the evil wizard in order to restore peace to the city.
The labyrinth is explored from a side scrolling perspective. It is composed of 64 room spread over five levels. Each room is 8 screens large, providing a total of 512 screens to explore. The goal of each level is to find a piece of the Talisman while fighting off lots of different monsters ranging from birds to jumping eyeballs to fire-breathing dragons. 
The hero can jump, climb ropes, swim and shoot as well as pick up different power-ups and objects. He can carry five objects, but only hold/use one at a time. Pressing the space bar changes the object in use. Usable objects include keys, ropes, lamps to light dark rooms, flags that improve the hero's firepower and others. 
Power-ups can be collected to replenish health or air. If the hero runs out of air, being underwater will slowly decrease his health. To help the hero finding his way through the labyrinth, a map is shown at the lower left side of the screen. It marks all visited rooms, shows his current position and indicates whether there are any items in a room.

El famoso juego de tablero "fantasy" se ha convertido en un juego de rol de vista isométrica en el que hay que derrotar al malvado mago Morcar. Tomas el control de un mago, un enano, un bárbaro y un elfo (cada uno con habilidades diferentes), que comienzan las misiones desde lados opuestos del tablero.
Los movimientos se determinan mediante una tirada de dados, y sólo se pueden realizar otras acciones antes o después del movimiento. Estos movimientos se realizan mediante un sistema basado en iconos. Los personajes pueden luchar contra los numerosos monstruos que acechan o lanzar hechizos para derrotarlos. Hay pociones mágicas que descubrir, pero también trampas ocultas, por lo que se recomienda trazar un mapa. Los tesoros se pueden recoger e intercambiar en la tienda después de cada nivel.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.08 KB

The Alliance of Space Pilots has stolen a dangerous weapon called Z-Ray. A rebel sector of the Alliance sends a "Herobot" into their base to retrieve the weapon along with important data.
Players take control of the Herobot and must find all six parts of the Z-Ray and download the data from the main computer. There are 12 different enemy droids that attack in different ways, some follow a set path, some charge the Herobot and a few can shoot. The Herobot can  shoot at his enemies or use an energy bomb that destroys everything onscreen, but also depletes half of its energy. The base is laid out like a maze with energy barriers and conveyor belts blocking the robot's progress. Energy barriers can be turned off via switches, while conveyor belts can only be stopped temporarily by accessing terminals. Terminals can also be used to display a small map of the surroundings.

meta.name: Heroes of Karn
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.31 KB

A long time ago, before the rise of the empire of Karn, evil creatures attacked the lands of Beren, the last of the Mountain Kings. Only four men, who would become known as the four heroes of Karn, survived the massacre and managed to flee. However, they were soon caught and put under a spell. The player takes on the role of the legendary Stranger from "a land where men can fly and machines can think", and must rescue the four heroes and retrieve the treasures of the realm.
Heroes of Karn is an Interactive Fiction game with graphics and more unusually, music. You can type in commands to manipulate objects, solve puzzles or attack enemies. While it is not possible to have conversations with NPCs, you can give them orders to do certain tasks.

Basado en las últimas partes del libro "Dragonlance Dragons of Autumn Twilight", los héroes descienden a una ciudad en ruinas en busca de los discos de Mishakal.
El juego consiste en un combate horizontal con un mapa laberíntico, utilizando puertas para cambiar la vista. El grupo está formado por los 8 Héroes de la Lanza, utilizando uno a la vez y el jugador puede cambiar entre ellos en cualquier momento. Cada personaje tiene diferentes tipos de ataques y hechizos, lo que los hace más adecuados para luchar contra diferentes enemigos y comportarse como personas reales.
Uno de los juegos de AD&D que se desmarca del RPG habitual.

Take The Challenge! Test your knowledge and intellect across a broad range of subjects. Stretch your powers of recall and memory. Can you outwit your friends in each of the four levels of difficulty? Can you beat the clock to answer the questions? Hi-Q-Quiz requires skill and judgement, and a little luck, to move around the board in your attempt to be first back to the Hi-Q Base. Answer questions on Sport, Entertainment, Geography, History, Art and Science. Tease your brain and enjoy this exciting and stimulating game!

meta.desc:

Searching for a new power source, scientists have been working on Delta Radiation. This form of radiation is far stronger than thought and has started seeping out of its container. This has caused the underground life forms to mutate. The mutants now want to destroy the plant and the world.
You have been chosen to drive a tank and enter the complex to destroy the mutants and to stop the radiation from leaking. There is one source of the leak on four levels and each one must be stopped. To do this, eight lead blocks have to be collected one at a time and placed around the container. Once one container is surrounded then it's onto the next level. Be careful though as your tank has limited fuel and ammo. These can be topped up with icons scattered around the levels.

Año 2040: una terrible epidemia asola París, Nueva York y Shanghái con distinta intensidad. Como joven médico, te encuentras en una de estas ciudades y debes enfrentarte a los mayores peligros para vacunar y salvar al máximo número de personas. Las víctimas se transforman en horribles monstruos. Armado con jeringuillas, ¡salva a la humanidad de esta plaga!

meta.name: High Noon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.52 KB

High Noon is a simple text-only Western gunfight duel simulation and was originally created as a BASIC game as early as 1970.
You have been challenged to a showdown by Black Bart, one of the meanest desperadoes west of the Allegheny mountains. 
The game starts with both of you 100 paces apart; you and Bart both have four shells in their gun. In each turn, you can either advance (thereby increasing hit chances for both), fire, jump behind a trough, run or give up.

meta.desc:

High Steel combina plataformas y puzles. Eres un obrero experto en construir rascacielos con estructuras metálicas, pero esta obra está infestada de gremlins y tiene límite de tiempo.
La vista es lateral: mueves al obrero y la grúa baja materiales. Para completar una planta (cinco segmentos sobre ≥2 vigas), primero colocas vigas verticales y luego los segmentos. Puedes escalar por las vigas. El número de plantas exigidas sube progresivamente. La grúa también trae comida y bebida, que aumentan energía y puntuación.
Los gremlins caminan, comen segmentos y te aturden si te golpean en la cabeza. Dejan huevos que eclosionan en madres (letales, pero se matan con llaves inglesas), que a su vez generan crawlers igual de peligrosos. Los spitters brotan de vigas y escupen ácido. Otros peligros: ladrillos que caen y cáscaras de plátano que causan resbalones.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.83 KB

The 1986 cult film Highlander is the basis of this adaptation, which reduces the film to its swordfighting scenes. Taking the role of the immortal Highlander Connor MacLeod, the player has to win three consecutive battles against increasingly skilled opponents: MacLeod's teacher Ramirez, a character named Fizir, and finally the mighty Kurgan, the main antagonist of the movie.
A battle is won by depleting the enemy of his energy. Energy is lost by being hit, or by attempting an attack that is blocked by the enemy. To win, a combination of attacking and parrying moves is necessary, of which several are available depending on the character's stance (standing or crouched) and the direction the joystick is pushed.
Two players can engage in a duel in two-player mode.

En este juego isométrico de acción y estrategia en 3D, el jugador usa un droide Vorton para empujar una bomba hasta el final de la carretera hacia una base alienígena. meta.name: Hijack
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.47 KB

You are the head of the US Governments Hijack Division, and you are called into action when a group of terrorists hijack a vehicle. You have three potential ways to foil them  get enough money to bribe them, use political influence to over-rule them, or bring in military force. To achieve any of these tasks, you will need to work with the President, FBI and CIA agents, Military and Political Advisers, and other staff including the Secretary to keep you in contact with them. You have a time limit, which the President can attempt to extend with the hijackers if you request this.
You control your characters left-right movement through the buildings directly, including entering lifts to switch rooms, but moving the controller up or down moves a cursor along rows of icons at the top and bottom of the screen. The screen also has graphs to indicate your current political, military and financial situations.
Most important of these are the chances to interact with other staff members, provided they are in the room. There are at least two requests you can make to each of them  The President can be asked for more support, an FBI Agent can question staff to ensure that there is no inside information. CIA Agents can give information about the hijackers, with 3 levels of detail, the more advanced ones taking longer. Press releases must be issued to ensure good publicity (and thus keep the President on your side) and funds raised to help with a financial solution.
Your final target is to go to the scene of the hijack and negotiate with the terrorists. You can bring your key advisers with you, to increase the chance of a correct outcome.

It is with a little taste of conquering the West and the gold rush that you meet this game which promises to make you see all the colors, although it is in black and white. Indeed, on a call from a friend named Ricky, you land in the charming city called NEWHOLE; you are firmly determined to discover the famous treasure. But to achieve your goals, you will need to use all your skills to glean useful information and make the right friends. A magnificent Far-West setting is planted with this city where nothing is missing: saloon, hotel, sheriff, prison ... The graphics are superb and the vocabulary is very flexible in use. French language text adventure.

meta.name: Hive
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 35.21 KB

A huge bee hive appeared on Earth and the inhabitants are less than friendly. The player's mission is to kill the queen by entering the hive with a special vehicle representing a grasshopper. The basic goal of each level is to find the exit which is is made more difficult by the maze-like structure of the tunnels. Three markers can be dropped at will as waypoints.
Of course the player also faces opposition from various enemies and obstacles which can be either shot or dodged by ducking respectively jumping. There are also various items to find which are stored in an inventory until used, e.g. shields, enemy freeze or a grabber to reach objects from a distance. The grasshopper uses up energy which is either taken from pylons or the life force. Obviously the latter is not desirable because reaching zero life force results in death - so the player needs to find pylons inside the hive. When having two pylons, the life force automatically recharges. Two specialities of the game are the vector graphics and a password which is constantly updated and always on screen.

meta.desc:

Relive Tolkien's The Hobbit as Bilbo Baggins.  A piece of  Interactive fiction (with graphics to illustrate locations), you follow the plot of Tolkien's book (before the Lord of the Rings trilogy), starting with an encounter with Gandalf and Thorin.
The implementation is rich enough that you can play entirely without pictures if you wish.  Also, gameplay happens in realtime, uncommon for interactive fiction.

meta.name: Hobgoblin
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.21 KB

En la lejana tierra de Altoris, rodeada por todos lados por densos bosques y asfixiantes pantanos, vive el pacífico pueblo gobernado por el bondadoso rey Garath. A pesar de los constantes ataques de duendes y fantasmas de los pantanos, el Globo de Oro garantizó la seguridad de las personas. Ahora que el Globo de Oro ha sido robado, la oscuridad ha descendido sobre Altoris. El rey ha encargado a su hijo Zanock que lo encuentre. "¡Necesitarás todo tu coraje y habilidad si quieres encontrar el Globo de Oro y así salvar a nuestra gente!"

Eres un atracador que conduce un rápido coche rojo por una ciudad francesa de calles estrechas. La furgoneta blindada con bolsas de dinero también está en la ciudad. Debes localizarla usando tu radar y recoger el dinero. La Gendarmerie (policía francesa) sabe de tu presencia y quiere abortar tu misión matándote, así que debes evitarla o escapar dejando manchas de aceite en la carretera. Durante la conducción, el combustible se agota, por lo que deberás repostar en una gasolinera.

A three-part or three instalment public domain adventure for Amstrad CP/M (Holiday, Holiday II & Holiday III).

meta.name: Hollywood Hijinx
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 85.56 KB

As a child, you spent most of your summers with your Aunt Hildegarde and Uncle Buddy. What memories! Uncle Buddy was a Hollywood big-shot, Aunt Hildegarde his loving (and very rich) wife. They had no children of their own, but you and your cousins loved their house, their parties, the Hollywood memorabilia, and them. Sure, Buddy and Hildy were a bit eccentric -- but that added to their charm. 
Aunt Hildegarde kept the house when Uncle Buddy passed away. And now that she's suddenly died, you remember her unusual will. You will inherit the entire estate -- probably worth millions if you can spend just one night in the house and on the grounds, find a treasure or two. But if you can't then you inherit nothing. 
And so Hollywood Hijinx begins with you being dropped off in front of a dark house, not to far from Hollywood ...

meta.name: Hollywood or Bust
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.67 KB

You are an actor called Buster Baloney in the early days of cinema and you are to search a studio for five missing Oscars while being filmed. The studio is is viewed from the side with a small part shown on the screen with the screen scrolling when you move. You must search various floors of the studio connected by ladders as you enter doors to film sets. Patrolling the studio are security guards which can be avoided or shot with custard pies, or ghosts which need avoiding but will only attack behind you so you can stand against walls. If you do get touched by a guard or ghost then it is game over.
Occasionally a door will lead to the street and here you will be chased by a huge amount of Kops. The screen is viewed from the side but at a high elevated angle and the screen scrolls constantly from left to right. As you walk along the street the Kops will try to hit you but they can be stopped by a custard pie. You have a gauge which decreases if you are hit and when it is empty then it is game over. Custard pies can be topped up by turning a tap at the top of the screen and collecting the custard at the bottom.

La antes tranquila ciudad de Grove Town sufre ahora un problema de delincuencia: cuatro peligrosos criminales andan sueltos cometiendo crímenes. meta.name: L' Horloger 1
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 11.64 KB

Timeman One is an educational game aimed at helping children tell the time.
The game screen consists of a clock to the right of which is a little man on a ladder. The game asks a series of questions which either require the player to state what time the clock is displaying or to move the hands of the clock to a specific time. If the player answers correctly the game displays a smiley face and the little man moves two steps up the ladder. If the answer is incorrect the little man moves down one step and the game displays a sad face but gives the player another chance at the question. If the second answer is incorrect the game shows the player the correctly answer before offering a new question. Each session is played until the little man reaches the top of the ladder when the game plays some happy music and the little man plants a flag and dances.
There are six games, 
Three 'Telling the Time' games;
The Hours game in which the game sets the time at something o'clock and the player must respond to the question 'What time is it? __ o'clock' by entering the correct number
The Minutes game in which the game shows a clock with the minute hand only and the numbers 5 - 60 on the outside. The minute hand points to a number and the player must answer questions such as 'How many minutes here? __ minutes' by entering the correct number
The Hours & Minutes game in which the game shows a regular clock with both hands. The player must answer questions such as 'Set the time to 20 minutes past 11 o'clock
and three 'Setting the Time' games
The Hours game in which the game gives the player a time and asks them to set the hour hand correctly
The Minutes game in which the game gives the player a time and asks them to set the minute hand correctly
The Hours & Minutes game in which the gives the player a time and asks them to set both the hour hand and minute hands correctly
The default time interval for all the above games is five minutes but the games can be made more challenging by setting the default interval to one minute. This option is available as an option from the main menu.
The game requires each player to sign in and it keeps a record of  their achievement which can be viewed from the main menu.

Hot Rod es un juego de carreras con vista cenital inspirado en Super Sprint, donde tres coches miniatura compiten por completar una carrera lo más rápido posible, girando, acelerando y frenando en los momentos adecuados. Comienzas con combustible limitado, pero puedes recoger más al recorrer la pista. Golpear obstáculos puede hacer explotar tu coche, perdiendo tiempo mientras se reemplaza.
Insólitamente, las pistas son lineales —no por vueltas—, así que cada ronda consiste en recorrer una sección de pista una sola vez. Tras cada carrera, puedes comprar mejoras en la tienda, según el dinero ganado en la anterior.
Solo se muestra una parte de la pista a la vez, que se desplaza siguiendo al líder. Si no logras mantenerte a su altura, tu coche avanza forzadamente en la pista, con una penalización de combustible. Esto recuerda levemente al sistema usado después en los modos head-to-head de Micro Machines, y resulta especialmente castigador cuando estás en tramos horizontales mientras el coche líder (CPU) avanza verticalmente, reduciendo mucho el margen de error.

Hotshot es un sencillo juego para dos jugadores lanzado con gran campaña publicitaria. Tú y otro jugador (humano o IA) os enfrentáis en una arena dividida por la mitad, con un hueco central —de unos dos tercios de la altura de la pantalla— por donde circula la bola, y una serie de ladrillos a cada lado que destruir.
El objetivo es eliminar tus ladrillos antes que tu oponente los suyos. Para ello, atrapas la bola apuntándola con tu dispositivo de succión y manteniendo pulsado el disparo; luego la lanzas soltando el botón. Esto resulta más difícil de lo que parece, pues la bola no se mueve en línea recta ni sigue las leyes naturales de la gravedad.
Si la bola te impacta sin que la atrapes correctamente, caes derribado y el rival obtiene la posesión.

This Gauntlet-inspired arcade adventure has three separate challenges, each of which can be loaded from the main screen. All are viewed from above, and involve shooting enemies (contact with whom drains your energy). Your health is represented by gradually-withering pineapples, which are recharged by eating food.
The first is set in Egypt - you are locked inside a treasure-packed temple, and must escape through seven locked doors, each of which has its own key. The second sees you on a doomed spaceship, needing to collect security passes and circuit board pieces. The third is in a city full of mutants - escape passages are locked and a crucial document is in 24 pieces.
The minimum target of escaping involves collecting keys - note that each barrier has only one way of being opened. To be a true hero, you must collect the sets of 24 treasure pieces/circuit board pieces/torn document pieces within the levels.

Victor Hugo jamás imaginó que su creación Quasimodo, el jorobado de Notre Dame, correría un circuito de obstáculos como el de este juego: esquivando bolas de fuego y flechas, saltando fosos y lanceros, a veces ayudado por una cuerda de campana que se balancea, con la esperanza de rescatar a su amada Esmeralda desde la torre más alta… todo mientras es perseguido lenta pero implacablemente por un caballero invencible, de armadura completa, por los parapetos del castillo. Una vez que dominas un obstáculo, el juego los combina, hasta que, al final, debes seguir simultáneamente el balanceo de la cuerda, el embiste de la lanza, la trayectoria de la flecha y el avance del caballero. ¡Si lo logras contra todo pronóstico, te toca repetirlo… pero más rápido! Incluso un protagonista ágil tendría dificultades para manejar tantas amenazas a la vez, pero intuyo que un jugador dedicado, con paciencia y buen timing, puede superarlas. Llamémoslo un presentimiento.

meta.name: Hunter-Killer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.46 KB

Hunter Killer is a submarine simulation game set in the North Sea off the German / Danish Helegoland coast during the Second World War. You are the commander of a British 'S' type submarine on a mission to find an enemy submarine in the area and sink it. The coast is heavily mined, so sailing in too close, may result in hitting a mine or running aground. Going outside the area will expose you to destroyers that are hunting for you. Aircraft patrol the area, so staying on the surface can be fatal.
The game has three views, Control Room, Periscope and Chart Room. In the control room the player operates the submarine's engines and ballast, the periscope is used to find enemy vessels and the chart room to navigate. Once an the enemy sub is in range and dead ahead, it is time to launch a torpedo for the kill.
The game has five levels of difficulty. Once the enemy sub has been dispatched, the game moves to the next target. If you are sunk, it is game over.

meta.name: Hurlements
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.40 KB

Hurlements (translated as Howls) is a horror adventure game in which you play as either Kane a small-time thief and his girlfriend Lorry, on a quest to find a stash of gold, mentioned to him by an old cell mate that had died. The problem is, your car breaks down, and now you must find the gold, repair your vehicle and get out of there before you are mauled by werewolves. 
While being an adventure game first and foremost, the addition of fights and item management adds some minor RPG elements. It is controlled entirely with the keyboard using a selection of icons to perform whatever action you so choose. There are some oddly specific actions including ones for sleeping, waking and eating. This means you need to pay attention to your tiredness and hunger but, along with health, it's represented by a single life bar.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.33 KB

Some aliens from Venus have landed on Earth to live but have got more powerful so they have been put in gaol to stop them using their power for evil. The gaol wasn't built to keep them in but to stop people and aliens getting in to attempt a rescue mission. The gaol is starting to struggle to hold them so the aliens need to be destroyed. The only way to do this is by sending a team of droids in. The gaol is full of other creatures and defences all put in place to stop anyone getting in, these include Cannons, mines, electro wire and many types of creatures. There are three types of droids, The Brain, The Robot and The Xylon, each with different powers and abilities like switching bridges on, high fire power and teleporting. Once the droids reach a certain cell in the complex together they unite and become a 'Hybrid' where they are transported to a cell of an alien to destroy it. Once the alien is destroyed then they are transported back to the complex and another three aliens need to be found and destroyed to save Earth.

Después de su improbable éxito en Sweevo's World, el robot menos capaz del mundo está de regreso, y debe ir al Deathbowl muy contaminado y limpiarlo. Los cuatro tapones del Deathbowl deben retirarse, en orden, para drenar el agua venenosa y permitir que se vuelva a llenar.
Deben obtenerse los objetos específicos necesarios para despejar cada enchufe, en muchos casos disparando a los enemigos que los sostienen, una tarea que se hace más difícil por el hecho de que el contacto con ellos es fatal, se comienza sin armamento y ningún arma tiene munición ilimitada. Se deben usar remolinos y burbujas para alcanzar las diversas áreas del Deathbowl. El contacto con el agua hace que Sweevo comience a oxidarse, aunque se puede recoger aceite para limitar el efecto. El juego se ve isométricamente y presenta más de 200 pantallas de acción y rompecabezas (más en modo 128K).

meta.name: Hyper Sports
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.12 KB

Six tough events await in this joystick-waggling action game. The full sequence of events is - swimming, skeet shooting, gymnastics, archery, triple jumping and weightlifting. You must complete each event in order to be allowed onto the next one.
Swimming involves moving left and right as fast as possible, while pressing fire when a breath is required. Skeet shooting and archery both come down to timing - though elevation and wind factors affect the latter. Gymnastics involves timing a succession of presses to ensure that the jump is long and the landing graceful. The triple jump involves one press for each part of the jump, whereas the weightlifting involves merely brute strength.

meta.name: Hyperbowl
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.89 KB

Hyperbowl is a one-on-one futuristic sport viewed from above, with a small amount of the rectangular pitch visible at a time.  Each player controls one of the 10 available spaceships, each with their own subtle strengths and weaknesses in terms of speed, inertia and fire direction. A scanner shows the positions of both ships and the ball, so that things don't become disorientating.
The aim is to guide the ball either into a 'goal' in the middle of each end (scoring 2 points) or onto the goal-line elsewhere (scoring one point). The ball can be steered either by hitting it with the ship or by shooting at it with your craft's beam (which does not injure or impede the opposition craft in any way). In either case the ball moves in a semi-random direction similar to the one you directed it in, but can rebound off the plus-shaped divots in the wall unexpectedly.
The game lasts for 5 minutes, or until a player reaches the winning score of 9. Each of the three skills levels is a 5-tier tournament of increasing difficulty.

Icon Jon es un juego con una premisa única: el jugador controla a Icon Jon, un programa dentro de un ordenador CPC. Desafortunadamente, este se apagará pronto, lo que significa que Icon Jon será borrado de la RAM activa. ¡Así que debe escapar!

This software allows each student to write their own tale, offering them a framework conforming to the traditional structure of the marvelous tale analyzed by W.Propp in “Morphology of the tale”. meta.name: L'Ile Oubliée
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 74.33 KB

Parti à la recherche de votre frère disparu en mer, votre propre navire fait naufrage au cours d'une violente tempête. Vous vous réveillez sur une plage et découvrez rapidement que vous avez échoué sur une île déserte. Votre objectif est désormais d'explorer l'île à la recherche d'un moyen de vous en échapper.
Jeu d'aventure à analyseur syntaxique développé tardivement au chevet d'un CPC au crépuscule de sa vie, L'ÎLE OUBLIÉE veut rendre hommage aux jeux créés par la société Lankhor dont son développeur semble passionné puisqu'il va jusqu'à en reprendre malicieusement le design de la page des crédits. Et le disciple n'est pas loin d'égaler le maître car si l'on fait abstraction de quelques petites incohérences, d'une absence de raccourcis parfois agaçante mais surtout d'une orthographe défaillante, le scénario mature et bien ficelé ainsi que des graphismes somptueux et variés plongent rapidement le joueur dans une aventure pleine d'exotisme dont savait si bien nous abreuver l'éditeur à la plume. Il ne lui manque donc pas grand-chose pour avoir la trempe d'une production commerciale et on ne saurait que trop vous conseiller cette pépite malheureusement restée méconnue.

Impossaball puts you in control of a ball, and sets you in a checkered 3D environment with walls and ceilings. The ball bounces on the spot as standard, but can be directed to move, or bounce higher to gain momentum. Juegas como Indy, que debe atravesar tres niveles que se repiten.

meta.name: Infodroid
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.73 KB

Infodroid is set on a planet which exclusively deals with administration and focuses on the delivery of information and packages. The player is in charge of a startup company and tries to become a big player within a established competition.
All deliveries are executed by droids which travel on five streams (two forward and two backwards) with different speeds; the central being static and allowing to enter a variety of rooms: junctions, dispatch rooms in which new delivery jobs can be taken and old ones concluded, information rooms where the game options can be changed and garages for repair duties. On the way, droids from other companies try to ram the player (hence the need for repairs) which need to be avoided by jumping between the streams. With money earned by delivering packages to the correct destination, new droids can be bought or the old ones upgraded, e.g. better shields or boosts which allow to jump multiple streams at once.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 120.38 KB

Ingrid is Ingrid Bottomlow, the intellectual-but-clumsy gnome we met in Gnome Ranger. Her beloved home village Little Moaning is earmarked for a yuppie-friendly transformation by Jasper Quickbuck of Ridley's Manor. 
Ingrid has three cunning plans to stop him - producing a petition with everybody's signature, finding a more orthodox prevention method, and finally infiltrating Ridley's Manor itself by pretending to be a maid, and then finding proof that he's a dodgy geezer who should be locked up. These three quests can be played in any order, although they logically follow on from each other. She is accompanied by Flopsy the dog in the first 2 parts, and her cousin Daisy in the third.
Ingrid's Back uses the same game system as the original, and other contemporary Level 9 titles such as Knight Orc . Giving instructions to other characters (including Flopsy) and jumping around the map using GO TO and FOLLOW commands. A living and breathing world of people travelling, trading and relaxing underpins it all, and plays a part in most puzzles.

As a space pilot sent on a dangerous mission, the player must visit an asteroid - former shelter of mad Myriadians scientists - to recover their inventions preserved on disks containing scientific data. meta.name: Insector Hecti In The Interchange
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.07 KB

You play the role of Insector Hecti, a computerised detective who explores and protects computer circuits. You have been sent to the Interchange, a highly sensitive area, which has been invaded by Victor Virus and his gang of bugs. On 50 circuits they have changed the direction of some of the blocks on each circuit and your task is to straighten them all back up. Viewed from above with each circuit shown on screen you must walk along the circuits to the misaligned pieces and turn them back round to the correct position and a ping sounds when it is in the correct position.
As you sort the circuit some of Victor's bugs roam the circuits as well and you can either avoid them, shoot them with limited balls or turn a piece of circuit round when they are next to it to destroy them. Once all the bugs have been destroyed they don't reappear. If you touch a bug, fall through a gap or fall of the edge of the circuit then you lose one of five lives and when all lives are gone it is game over. There is a password provided after every five levels to stop you repeating too many circuits. There is also a clock counting down and the circuit must be completed within the time. Occasionally some items appear to help you and these are extra balls, smart bomb, shield (limited), extra speed, freeze all bugs, extra time and stop timer.

Para llegar a cada instalación, avanza de izquierda a derecha en un juego de desplazamiento lateral. Bugs no solo camina por la superficie: en diversos puntos puede optar por adentrarse bajo tierra.

meta.name: International Rugby
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.85 KB

While rugby is a popular sport, few rugby games were released for the CPC. This game includes options for one or two players, and you can practice or play a championship league. The screen is reminiscent of Football Manager 2, being split into three sections, which can be annoying at times when you are carrying the ball into the next screen and find it's been taken from you.

meta.name: International Rugby Simulator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.93 KB

Seven-a-side rugby union is brought to life in this budget game.  The action is viewed from the side, although kicks to the posts are played from a behind-the-posts perspective. Scrums and line-outs are incorporated for as realistic a game as possible given the player restriction. A tournament can be played with up to 8 players, with as many computer teams as required to fill the gaps.
In the ST version the tactical side of the game is very complex - seventeen different formations are on offer. Other gameplay variables can be set - player stamina (lower values forcing you to play a more conservative game), how long a player takes to recover from a tackle, and the standard strengths of passes and kicks, pus some very complicated mathematical coefficients. The ability to rename teams, change kits and alter the match lengths seem banal by comparison.

meta.name: Into Oblivion
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.25 KB

Según el texto «Aim of the Game» en el reverso de la carátula, este juego es continuación de Nonterraqueous 2 (Soul of a Robot) (tras la destrucción de la computadora maligna).
En este juego debes recolectar realmente «Psyche» —en los anteriores Nonterraqueous, ya la poseías—.
Hay 42 planetas por explorar; en Nonterraqueous había 42 niveles.
Controlas al «Seeker MK II»; el «Seeker» original apareció en Nonterraqueous.
Uno de los planetas se llama Nonterra.

meta.name: Into the Eagle's Nest
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.87 KB

Debes infiltrarte en el cuartel general nazi Eagle's Nest. Tres soldados aliados han sido capturados, y debes infiltrarte en las instalaciones, rescatar a tus valientes camaradas, destruir el edificio y rescatar la mayor cantidad posible de tesoros artísticos robados.
Hay ocho niveles para explorar, cada uno con un objetivo de misión específico. Algunos de los cuadros están sueltos, otros están en cajas a las que primero hay que disparar. Los explosivos deben recogerse, no dispararse. Con munición limitada, guardias por todas partes, llaves escasas y muchos escondites estratégicos, requiere que el jugador preparare un plan de acción, en lugar de correr sin pensar.

meta.name: Invitation
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.37 KB

Receiving the invitation telegram from some "mysterious" Baron, you as journalist specialized in occult sciences have agreed to visit his manor. At first glance, his residence seems absolutely uninhabited, but searching room by room you'll find some items: a crucifix, flasks, a key, a revolver, a dirk... It seems that here is somebody to fight.
The gameplay includes walking around the manor (left, right, forward and turn round) and choosing the actions such as search the rooms for useful items during some amount of time, use these items, read, and fight with the creatures inhabited the manor such as bats, rats, cobras, fanatics, etc. Attacking you, monsters take down your potential and mental health until you will be moved to the manor's cemetery. So you have to survive for certain period of time until midnight. Also you have to search for the clues such as secret codes to solve the mystery around the Baron and his manor, finally find and burn the pentagram.

meta.desc:

El Reino Verde era una tierra próspera y pacífica bajo el reinado del rey Tibor, que esperaba tranquilamente a que su hijo creciera y le entregara su hacienda. Una noche, Zolphar, el hermano de Tibor, exiliado durante años tras un complot fallido para hacerse con el trono, regresa de entre los muertos. Los dos hermanos se reconcilian, pero Zolphar, utilizando magia diabólica, mata a Tibor y levanta un ejército de demonios contra el reino. El capitán Maltholm consigue escapar después de que sus soldados hayan sido diezmados por las criaturas, y salva la vida del hijo del rey. En los años siguientes, mientras Zolphar consigue gobernar el reino, Maltholm entrena al niño para la lucha. Ya adulto, le encomienda la tarea de vengar a su padre, reunir un ejército y matar a Zolphar. Eres el soldado entrenado en el código de honor de los Señores de Hierro.

meta.name: Iron Trackers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 61.32 KB

Transport on Quad bikes is the only available form of transportation in a post nuclear disaster world, and it is your occupation. It is very dangerous, and you need to survive racing from city to city. Equipping your Quad with different weapons and engines, you should choose your route and traverse swamp roads, inner city streets, and forest tracks to complete your mission. 
In your quest you will encounter Mutant Appendages that will drag you into the murky depths of the swamp; fences, walls, barriers, and traps which you must avoid; primitive natives, and wild animals; police vehicles and Urban Warriors who will stop at nothing to catch and kill you.
The game is third-person racing action arcade, where the player controls a Quad and shoots the enemies with the weapon chosen for it.
Gameplay is available for one or two players. In two players mode the screen is split on two sides, and each player may play in cooperative or competitive mode.

meta.name: Ishido
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.32 KB

Ishido es un juego de estrategia para un jugador, controlado por medio de un mouse. Esta es una implementación realizada por Ishido: The Way of Stones, un juego para Macintosh de los años noventa.
El juego se desarrolla en un tablero de 8x12. El jugador se presenta con una serie de fichas de colores, hay treinta y seis pares en total, cada una incluye un símbolo. Las fichas deben ser colocadas en el tablero de manera que estas coincidan en color y forman con las fichas colindantes. Los puntos son otorgados dependiendo de la cantidad y la complejidad de los movimientos realizados. El juego termina cuando todas las fichas han sido jugadas o cuando la siguiente ficha en juego no puede ser colocada en el tablero. Hay tres niveles de dificultad y tres juegos de piezas.

meta.name: Island
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.76 KB

The goal of the game is to find a hidden destination on an island, you have very little time to get there. A simple but addictive concept.

meta.name: The Island Of Dr. Destructo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.29 KB

Sólo tienes siete días para impedir que el Dr. Destructo lleve a cabo sus malvados planes y lance un ataque masivo a escala mundial.
Tu misión es destruir al Dr. Destructo y su isla fortaleza en sólo siete días. Los edificios y la flota del Imperio de Destructo se destruyen por el impacto de naves aéreas y espaciales derribadas, o por la bomba que se asigna a cada jugador por pantalla. Cada impacto eliminará una pequeña sección de la nave, isla o edificio. Cuando las secciones que faltan equivalen a una brecha que atraviesa la base, se crea una fuga y se forma un chorro de agua. La mayoría de los objetos necesitan tres fugas para ser destruidos con éxito.

meta.name: The Island
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.74 KB

The Island es una aventura de texto tradicional donde tu eres el protagonista el cuál ha sufrido un accidente aéreo en el océano y termino en una isla cercana. La isla es la punta de un volcán que alguna vez fue muy poderoso, rodeado por una cadena de volcanes activos. El objetivo es lograr escapar hacia la civilización.
Es conocido por sus largos laberintos y un tesoro el cuál obligada mente debe ser descubierto lo cuál lo diferenció de juegos de sus estilo contemporáneos.
La interacción del jugador es sencilla, únicamente mediante comandos que son verbos/sustantivos y no hay ningún tipo de contenido gráfico para ilustrar el juego.

meta.name: Isoleur
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.98 KB

The purpose of this game, which take place on the 12x12 matrix board is to block the opponent (computer). Every player's turn includes following actions: 
- Placing the pawn in cell (it moves as a Knight in chess); 
- Placing a block in cell to do not allow to place the pawn in such cell. 
Level of difficulty varies from 0 to 255, and ability to choose the first turn is present.

meta.name: Isotopes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.26 KB

Radioactive waste: dump it or recycle it. you just can't love it. In this game, you must guide a robot round the screen, whose job description reads isotopes eater'. He goes round quite happily, making the environment safer. Pity those rocks get in the way: they make a right mess of its digestive system.
Also, as the robot eats waste, it tends to mutate. To be precise, it grows. And making the robot try and eat itself is bad, bad news. It's hard to say exactly what makes this program so good: it could be the graphics, which are multicoloured. Might be the speed, which can be varied from arcade ace down to editor level. Have fun playing it. and don't go off the edge of the screen - you'll be terminated for dereliction of duty.

meta.name: Incredible Shrinking Sphere
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.96 KB

The Incredible Shrinking Sphere of the title comes under your control in this isometric maze game which has similarities to Marble Madness and Spindizzy. The ball needs to be guided from the start of a level to the end, through 4 linked sections.
Various functioning squares must be used to your advantage. Uniquely these include changes to the ball's size, as well as it's physics. Revolving squares randomly fire the ball off in another direction, and ramps shoot you in the current direction at high speed. Weapons can be collected, as can shields - both of which are required to avoid some of the hazards on show. Black holes are always fatal however.

It's a Knockout is based on the TV show of the same game. Players, each representing a an European country, compete in six arcade-style mini games to determine the winner. Each game is played in order and each player has its own turn. The goal of every mini game is to rack up as many points as possible in a limited amount of time - the player with the best score is rewarded with six points, the next with five and so on. After all games are played the winner with the highest amount of points wins the competition.Bronte Bash: Dinosaur heads come out of six horizontally places holes in random order. Players have to place a weight over the hole and smack them before they disappear again.
Flying Flans: Baked goods fall down from the top of the screen. Players have to catch them.
Harlem Hoppers: basically the same game as Flying Fans, just with balls which are rolled down from a camel's back.
Titanic Drop: A rope is tied from a ship with an angle. Players have to drop with the correct timing to land within one of the horizontally placed lifebelts.
Diet of Worms: Players control a bird who eats worms which pop on the screen. In this game there is an AI controlled second bird as competition.
Obstacle Race:a side scrolling-race in which players have to keep up the speed and jump over obstacles.

El jugador sólo puede elegir jugar como Inglaterra, Bélgica, Italia o España. Los equipos no tienen las franjas de colores correctos y el torneo no es igual que el Mundial real.

meta.name: Italian Supercar
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 34.47 KB

Italian Supercar is a sequel to the game Super Stuntman and features similar gameplay with the player having to drive a sports car through different film scenes. The car is seen from a top down perspective which scrolls vertically and the objective is simply to reach the far end of the course. It is necessary to avoid land mines that explode under the car and enemy cars that will attack in different ways in each level. The car has however a gun mounted which can be used to shoot down the enemies. Rocks, trees and buildings can be bumped into without damage while driving through water slows the car down. Ramps can be used to jump over obstacles. In each level the player has three lives as well as a time limit.

meta.name: Iznogoud
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.20 KB

This game from 1987 is based on the adventures of the French comic book character Iznogoud.   You are in the role of the Grand Vizier Iznogoud, whose only thought is to depose the Caliph of magical Baghdad and become "Caliph instead of the Caliph!"  To accomplish this aim, you must wander around and interact with characters around you, acquiring objects along the way that may or may not be useful, and figure out how all this will help you achieve your goal.
During the game, you have 4 different methods of interacting with other characters: you can give objects to them, you can threaten them, you can flatter them, and you can throw a tantrum.  Depending on the character, these actions will elicit different responses--or none altogether.  You will need objects for various things, and objects are all acquired from other characters.  Some characters are helpful, others are not.  But the right combination of your actions will help you to become Caliph instead of the Caliph, while the wrong ones will often land you in a cell beneath the palace.  Just be careful not to lose your own head in the process!

meta.name: Jack and the Beanstalk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.20 KB

Jack and the Beanstalk has the player controlling Jack, a young boy determined to steal the giant's treasures. The game consists of four levels. In the first level, Jack must climb a beanstalk to the top while avoiding worms, spiders, and birds. Jack may obtain a weapon in this level and use it to kill them. In the second level, Jack climbs a series of brick walls while avoiding the same enemies, and collects the money bag at the top and leaves the screen in the upper-left. On level three, Jack climbs the fireplace to get to the golden goose in the cage, then climbs down a ladder to the bottom. Finally, level four has Jack climb up the giant to reach the table, where a huge money bag resides. The game ends when Jack completes his objective or when all of his lives are lost.

meta.name: Jack the Nipper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 33.89 KB

Jack estaba cansado de todos los peleles de su pueblo, de sus juegos aburridos y de sus buenos modales para dormirle. Así que Jack, que tiene un carácter bastante desagradable, decidió animar un poco las cosas, cogió su fiel pistola de lunares y se dispuso a sembrar el caos. 
En "Jack the Nipper" guiarás a un bebé por la guardería, la comisaría de policía, el museo, las calles secundarias y los huertos. Al mismo tiempo, no pierdes ninguna oportunidad de realizar una serie de trucos desagradables.
Lo primero que tienes que buscar es tu pistola de guisantes para disparar a diversos objetos o personas.  A continuación, corre entre los adultos, tira los platos de la estantería, mata fantasmas con el lanzador de guisantes, descubre la tarjeta de crédito de mamá y ayuda a escapar a los delincuentes del pueblo. El objetivo está claro: ¡convertirse en el bebé más travieso de la historia! El juego termina cuando el contador de picardías alcanza el 100%.

"Jai Alai" es un juego basado en la Pelota Vasca, un deporte originario del País Vasco cuyas variantes son muy populares en el resto de España. 
Los partidos enfrentan a dos equipos (compuestos por dos jugadores cada uno), con un sistema de puntuación muy similar al del "ping-pong", es decir, el equipo puede puntuar si está en posesión del servicio, en el caso contrato, el ganar el punto solo le permite recuperarlo. En vez de una red, se juega lanzando la pelota contra un muro utilizado como un "tercer jugador".

You are Rankin Rodney and your task is to collect four instruments on a top view single screen and place them in their correct home over 20 levels. The screen is split into various coloured areas which are connected by different coloured moving circles. The coloured area you are on means you can only jump onto the same coloured circle and only jump off into the same coloured area. To change to a different colour you must jump onto a moving diamond which then allows you to jump onto a different coloured circle or into a different coloured area. In the centre of the screen are four triangles and you must move about the screen to get an instrument, once the instrument is collected, the triangle to place it on starts flashing. Once all four instruments are placed on their triangle, you move onto the next level. There are various notes and creatures moving about the screen as well and these can be collected for points but once you are carrying an instrument then touching these sends the instrument back to it's original place.

You are Rankin Rodney and your task is to collect four instruments on a top view single screen and place them in their correct home over 20 levels. The screen is split into various coloured areas which are connected by different coloured moving circles. The coloured area you are on means you can only jump onto the same coloured circle and only jump off into the same coloured area. To change to a different colour you must jump onto a moving diamond which then allows you to jump onto a different coloured circle or into a different coloured area. In the centre of the screen are four triangles and you must move about the screen to get an instrument, once the instrument is collected, the triangle to place it on starts flashing. Once all four instruments are placed on their triangle, you move onto the next level. There are various notes and creatures moving about the screen as well and these can be collected for points but once you are carrying an instrument then touching these sends the instrument back to it's original place.

Music notes have escaped throughout the world, and Jet-Boot Jack must collect them up. There are ten levels, the first five of which can be played from the main menu. meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.36 KB

The Game of King is a derivative of the game of chess. It opposes, on a chessboard of 81 squares, the camp of the king called Caesar, Henry IV or Napoleon, who at the start of the game, stands on the central square surrounded by 8 friendly pawns, and the camp of the 16 other pawns, distributed near the edge of the board. The king, always played by the computer, wins if he reaches one of the squares on the periphery. All the pieces move like chess rooks: a piece surrounded by 2 enemies is taken, the king mobilizes 4 enemies before surrendering. 2 starting arrangements, combined with the 3 strategies corresponding to the 3 kings, and combined with the 3 levels of difficulty, gives a singular richness to a simple game whose games, at the beginning, end, barely started, with a humiliating defeat of your camp.

Johnny Reb is a turn-based strategy game for one or two players, based on the American Civil War. Players can control an army of either the Union or the Confederation.
There are three types of units: infantry, cavalry and artillery, and it's possible to decide how many of each type the player's army should consist of. En Joust, los jugadores toman el control de un caballero con una lanza que monta su avestruz voladora (o cigüeña, para el jugador 2) para luchar contra malvados caballeros controlados por computadora que cabalgan sobre buitres.
Los jugadores deben batir las alas de su corcel para golpear al enemigo desde un punto de justa más alto y destruir al buitre y a su jinete. Una vez que el enemigo ha sido alcanzado, un huevo cae a una de las plataformas de abajo. Los heroicos caballeros deben destruir los huevos antes de que eclosionen y liberar a nuevos caballeros cada vez más difíciles. Las tres fortalezas de los caballeros enemigos son Bounder (caballero rojo), Hunter (caballero blanco) y Shadow Lord (caballero azul). Estos caballeros enemigos no son el único desafío que nos encontramos en el juego. Los jugadores también deben enfrentarse a plataformas que se desmoronan, trolls de lava que intentan arrastrar a los caballeros al fuego y al temido pterodáctilo "imbatible" (?).
El juego fue novedoso para su época por ser uno de los pocos juegos simultáneos para dos jugadores en la sala de juegos.

K.Y.A. (Keep Yourself Alive) es un juego de acción que enfrenta a jugadores Azul y Rojo. Al escapar por diez cuevas, deben luchar entre sí y contra droides para convertirse en maestros. Cada jugador controla una cápsula y dispara a oponentes, droides y muros destruibles tras recargar. Algunos muros cargan la cápsula; otros, la descargan. El diseño de las cuevas difiere totalmente entre las versiones para Amstrad y Thomson.

En el segundo nivel vas cabalgando a todo galope atravesando el desierto, saltando por matorrales y cactus para alcanzar el pueblo siguiente. En el nivel 4, vas de nuevo en tu caballo saltando arbustos para llegar a la locomotora y detenerla.

Jinborov Karnovski (conocido como Karnov) es un forzudo ruso de circo que busca todas las piezas de un mapa del tesoro para hacerse rico. Este tesoro perdido de Babilonia está custodiado por el malvado dragón Ryu. En la versión Famicom, la historia cambia: Karnov, natural de Cleamina, es llamado por Dios como su enviado para eliminar al maligno alborotador Alakatai.
El juego tiene nueve fases de acción con desplazamiento lateral. Su ataque principal es lanzar bolas de fuego; los orbes de mejora aumentan su potencia. Puede saltar —la altura sube al recoger botas— y portar diversos ítems: bombas, escaleras, bumeranes, clappers (eliminan enemigos menores al instante) y escudos. En ocasiones, usa alas para volar o un casco de buceo para nadar bajo el agua. Repartidas por las fases hay iconos «K»: al recoger 50, obtiene una vida extra.

En el siglo XXIV, explosiones solares obligan a los humanos a abandonar la Tierra, que es recolonizada por los peligrosos Kat Men. Al cesar las explosiones, los humanos regresan, pero estos se niegan a irse. Se envía entonces al dron MT-ED (Multi Terrain Exploration Droid), acompañado del dron de mantenimiento y combate Hercules 1. Tras el descenso, Hercules es secuestrado y llevado al Centro Nervioso de los Kat Men; MT-ED debe eliminarlos y rescatarlo. Para ello, explora 14 entornos con criaturas letales, cada una vulnerable a un arma específica: láser, bombas de agua, granadas o cohetes (recogibles y cambiables al instante). Si MT-ED toca a una criatura, sale despedido, queda aturdido y pierde una vida. Algunas no son letales, pero le roban las armas. También puede saltar sobre criaturas lentas. Tras rescatar a Hercules, debe superar un sub-juego; al lograrlo, se desactiva la Computadora Central de los Kat Men, que regresan a su origen.

meta.name: Kenny Dalglish Soccer Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.67 KB

By 1989 Kenny Dalglish scarcely played for Liverpool, and was almost entirely concentrating on his role as manager, so a football management game with no arcade action featuring his license made sense. The game is purely icon- and menu-driven, perhaps the first step in dragging the genre into the 90s. Whichever team you took charge of start from the 4th division. Match highlights can be selected - these are viewed from the side and show goals and near-misses, although they can be turned off.
You start with squads of over 20 players from which to choose your team of 11, each given a straightforward ability rating. Formations can be selected by placing each player in a precise position alongside the formation of the opposition team, using a fairly advanced system for the time. Via a separate menu you can consult with the chairman (to see if he's happy with your efforts), the physio (to check for injuries), the scout (who comes up with players you might like to purchase) and so on.

Kentilla is a text adventure with graphics. It is a sequel to an earlier text adventure by Derek Brewster, 
Velnor's Lair.
At the end of the previous game, Velnor was vanquished and his soul was hurled through the void into the flames of the Abyss. In the spilt second that the corridor was opened Grako returned from the Abyss and now controls the source of Velnor's power, the Moonstone of Aigrath. The object of the game is to defeat Grako and to return him to the flames of the Abyss. In this the player is aided by the mystical sword Kentilla and companions such as Elva, who can carry things as well as perform tasks and fight.
The game's text parser, in addition to accepting the normal commands of 'Go North' and 'Get item' allows the player to issue commands to others such as 'Say To Elva "Get Moss"'.
The game also plays music while the game is in progress.

Eres una tetera voladora que debe escapar de 30 niveles subterráneos vistos de perfil, con scroll al moverse. Cada nivel tiene una salida que solo se abre con un abrelatas, oculto en uno de varios Intestinos. Al destruir un Intestino con tu Crizza (que orbita y protege), obtienes: en el correcto, el abrelatas; en los demás, alienígenas, bonus o jarras de energía. Todos los Intestinos emiten burbujas: tocarlas o a un alienígena reduce tu energía; si se agota, pierdes. El Crizza destruye burbujas y alienígenas (estos requieren varios impactos); pulsando disparo lo lanzas adelante. Para romper un Intestino se necesitan 10 golpes; al destruirlo aparece un diamante; al romperlo, con suerte sale el abrelatas. Dos jugadores juegan en pantalla partida, cooperando o compitiendo (robando bonus). Al iniciar eliges comenzar en nivel 1 o 4; si completas el 4, en la próxima partida puedes empezar en niveles superiores.

The Key Factor es un juego arcade combinado con un tutor de mecanografía. La tarea del jugador es defender su planeta de una fuerza de invasores alienígenas. Los extraterrestres aparecen en la parte superior de la pantalla y descienden lentamente hacia la parte inferior. Debajo de cada fila de alienígenas hay diferentes letras, números u otras claves. Si una barrera se destruye por completo, el alienígena alcanzará la llave, lo que terminará el juego para el jugador. El juego consta de seis niveles, cada uno con una serie de oleadas con diferentes alienígenas que se vuelven cada vez más rápidas.

El juego ahora presenta modos de torneo completos (aunque los jugadores de los equipos son ficticios) y cuatro campos diferentes (incluida una implementación de campos de plástico, cuyo rebote desigual causó controversia cuando varios clubes británicos los probaron en los años 1980).

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.97 KB

Killed Until Dead is a sophisticated mystery game with a leaning towards humor. The player has to solve every aspect of a murder case before it happens. The five biggest mystery writers in the world have gathered together at a hotel and one of them will be offing another unless Hercule Holmes can crack the case.  
Gameplay is a cross between the board-game Clue and the paper-based logic puzzles in which the player must eliminate clues in sequence. To solve the forthcoming murder, you will have to search the suspects' rooms and confront them with the evidence and set the hotel's security cameras to record secret meetings. 
By questioning the suspects as to what they know about certain people, rooms and objects, they may reveal combinations they know will not be involved in the murder - perhaps if it involves the gun, the killer will not be Lord Peter Flimsey, for example.  However, there's a catch. If he accuses the wrong suspect, he might be the one who's Killed Until Dead - they don't take kindly to false accusation.

La acción se desarrolla en una pista circular: cada equipo de cinco jugadores debe meter la bola de hierro en el agujero del equipo contrario y evitar que hagan lo mismo. Los partidos tienen límite de tiempo, pero acaban si todos los jugadores de un equipo quedan inconscientes y se ha metido al menos una bola. Incluye modo entrenamiento (partido individual contra IA o humano) y torneo (ocho equipos, IA o humanos), con progreso guardable.

Killer Gorilla es un juego de plataformas en cuatro fases, ambientado en una obra. Las fases 1, 2 y 3 exigen llegar a la cima, donde tu novia está custodiada por el gorila del título. En la fase 4, debes eliminar los remaches de las vigas para derribarlo. Al completarla, el juego reinicia en la fase 1, más rápido y con más obstáculos. Es un clon de Donkey Kong. En la fase 1, el gorila lanza barriles; se evitan, saltan o rompen con un martillo temporal. Si un barril alcanza el barril ardiente de abajo, a veces se convierte en una bola de fuego errática. En la fase 2, cintas transportadoras mueven básculas de cemento (letales); aparecen bolas de fuego y escaleras se extienden/retraen. Hay martillo para romper ambos. En la fase 3, el gorila lanza vigas en I rebotando; hay ascensores móviles. En la fase 4, ocho remaches sujetan la cima; al pasar por ellos desaparecen. Al eliminar los ocho, se completa la fase y el ciclo reinicia.

meta.name: Knight Rider
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.49 KB

Knight Rider es un juego basado en la popular serie de televisión de los años ochentas. los protagonistas principales de la serie y del videojuego son KITT - un carro computarizado con varios implementos al estilo Bond - y Michael Knight, el conductor.
La trama empieza cuando el jefe de Michael, Deven, descrubre que un grupo de terroristas esta buscando sabotear reuniones claves entre oriente y occidente, incluso tratando de ocasionar una tercera guerra mundial.
El juego se basa alrededor de cinco misiones, cuatro de las cuales están listadas a continuación, y una quinta aleatoria.
The Democractic Convention
The U.N. Conference
The Trades Conference
The Presidential Dinner
Cada misión tiene un tiempo para ser completada. El juego es una combinación de conducción en primera persona y disparos juntos en una aventura con desarrollo vertical.
Para cada misión el jugador debe conducir al lugar designado para empezar. En el camino será atacado por oleadas de helicópteros disparando misiles.
El jugador puede elegir entre conducir y dejar que KITT se encargue de disparar, o disparar y dejar que KITT se encargue de la conducción. Los puntos se ganan en relación a la cantidad de helicópteros que han sido derribados y tanto Michael como KITT serán mas precisos a la hora de disparar si conducen más despacio, sin embargo esta característica esta condicionada con el tiempo límite para terminar la misión.
Una vez que hayan llegado al lugar objetivo, el jugador debe manejar a Michael alrededor de cuartos llenos de cajas y guardias para encontrar pistas y avanzar a la siguiente ubicación.

Tras rescatar al mago Gimbal, el Caballero Mágico es transportado al siglo XXV a bordo de la pacífica nave comercial USS Pisces, y debe encontrar el modo de regresar a su época. Knight Tyme es la tercera entrega de la serie. Como en Spellbound, el jugador interactúa mediante el sistema «Windimation»: al pulsar un botón aparece una ventana con comandos (coger/soltar/tomar/dar un objeto, examinar, ordenar a un personaje, leer, lanzar un hechizo, ponerse/quitarse un objeto). Se navega con las teclas de movimiento y se ejecuta con el mismo botón. El viaje espacial es clave: la nave debe visitar varios planetas y repostar, o el personaje quedará atrapado para siempre. Algunas salas matan al instante; suelen requerir resolver un puzle para acceder con seguridad.

Debes escapar de un laberinto en el corazón de un castillo. Puedes mover a tu personaje en un universo 3D y puedes interactuar con objetos usando un sistema de reconocimiento de palabras. meta.name: Kobyashi Naru
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 47.41 KB

Split into knowledge, wisdom and understanding sections, the Kobyashi Naru trial must be completed in order to gain immortal status. Collect the required objects from each one in this adventure game.
The game offers pictures of each location and significant objects, and a textual description of each location, but beyond this the game system is atypical of 1980s adventures, especially those originating on cassette. A set of icons is displayed in the top half of the screen, which are selected to activate movement, item manipulation, analysing the scene (by selecting specific words of text), and actions like ascending, throwing and swimming. Puzzle solving always uses objects either in the scene description or your inventory.

meta.name: Kokotoni Wilf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.44 KB

Kokotoni Wilf has been sent on a bold journey through time, to recover the seven pieces of the Dragon Amulet. There are 63 screens across 6 times zones to trek through in order to find these star-like objects.
These screens are viewed from the side, and resemble Jet Set Willy, except that Wilf can fly through them and hover at a precision point. With hazards ranging from dinosaurs to spears to spaceships, and pieces located in hard-to-reach places, you will need this extra skill, especially as you have no weaponry. Most screens have more than 2 exits, but some are dead ends or lead directly into hazardous points. On each world you can immediately access the first 3 screens.

Konami's Golf features a challenging 18 hole course and allows you to choose your club, adjust your stance and control your swing, applying hook and slice if desired (or inadvertently added). Wind and ball lie must be taken into account. 
The game features a split screen with two views, one an overhead view of the entire hole, and the other a 3-D view from your balls current location. The gameplay options include 1 player stroke play, 2 player stroke play, or 2 player match play.

meta.name: Konami's Ping Pong
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.37 KB

Ping Pong recrea el trepidante deporte del tenis de mesa. Para ganar cada partido, debes alcanzar los 10 puntos con una ventaja de 2 puntos; si el marcador llega a 10-9, el juego continúa hasta que alguien consiga una ventaja de 2 puntos o llegue a 15, de forma similar al tenis. Hay nueve niveles de dificultad que superar, con habilidades cada vez mayores a medida que avanza el juego. El jugador humano tiene la ventaja de sacar primero y, como el servicio se alterna cada cinco puntos, tienes garantizadas al menos tantas oportunidades de sacar como tu oponente (recuerda la importancia de los 10 y los 15 en la puntuación). El sistema de puntos premia los peloteos largos y los márgenes de victoria amplios, ya que obtienes puntos por cada golpe, por cada punto ganado y por cada punto del margen de victoria.

KRISTAX is an arcade game with an element of strategy. So don't rush to finish the levels. You live on KARiS, a dead moon. Your only source of life is Kristax, the formidable energy that powers your planet. But the evil XORK stole this energy from you to power a base on which he creates horrible mutants. Your mission is to recover the Kristax in the 12 sectors of the complex. Keys open doors, bombs open passages (a hole to the right of your hero), lasers immobilize a mutant which is, however, mortal if touched. Question marks are bonuses (or penalties).

meta.name: The Krypton Factor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.91 KB

In this game you take the role of a contestant in the TV game show The Krypton Factor. The gameplay is divided up into different types of mental skill including Observation in which you are told a story and shown a picture. The story is then told again but with subtle changes along with the picture which alters. You must then type in what text has changed and also what has altered on the picture. There are also mathematical puzzles involving you remembering a sequence and working out the sum quickly as the clock is ticking away. As the game progresses there are also physical tasks to do including moving the Ergobuggy around a course and finishing off with a general knowledge quiz.

meta.name: Kung-Fu
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.21 KB

This martial arts simulation features large and detailed characters drawn in line form. In the one player game you have 3 lives, losing one every time your opponent defeats you in a fight, and your target is to reach the black belt status and then defend it repeatedly. As well as launching attacking moves, you must be able to back away to avoid taking hits yourself. Once you hit your opponent (knocking off a Yin-Yang symbol) he becomes weaker for the next few seconds, and thus easier to knock down again. A slow motion action replay is built in.

Una conversión del juego de arcade del mismo nombre, que a su vez se basa libremente en una película, Kung-Fu Master es un juego de acción de desplazamiento lateral para uno o dos jugadores, que alternan turnos.
Thomas es capaz de moverse de izquierda a derecha, saltar, agacharse y dar puñetazos y patadas. Los proyectiles enemigos, como cuchillos, se pueden patear en el aire para que reboten hacia el enemigo. En el último piso reside el propio Sr. X.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 40.75 KB

Kwik Snax es un juego de acción y reflexión en el que tienes que recoger toda la fruta de un nivel sin que te golpeen los enemigos. El nivel se compone de 2 tipos de bloques: móviles (los cubitos de hielo del primer nivel), o fijos (los copos de nieve del primer nivel). Puedes empujar los bloques móviles para despejar un camino o aplastar a un enemigo. En comparación con otros juegos de este tipo, hay una ventaja: puedes empujar tantos bloques móviles a la vez como quieras, siempre que no haya bloques fijos o frutas bloqueando tu línea de bloques móviles. Es más, puedes mover o empujar bloques a través de los límites del nivel: lo que sale por la izquierda o por la parte inferior de la pantalla reaparece por la derecha o por la parte superior, y viceversa.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 74.02 KB

Para el 2011, la única forma de viajar a la máxima velocidad es en vías aéreas construidas muy por encima del suelo. Estos se vuelven populares entre los corredores de niños y los fanáticos de la velocidad en general con bastante rapidez, y es por eso que pretendes atravesarlos en esta conversión de arcade.
El camino se desplaza verticalmente, con algunas curvas moderadamente pronunciadas de una manera similar a Spy Hunter. Tienes un dispositivo de salto para superar los muchos saltos, o para aterrizar y aplastar a los otros maníacos que se alinean en el camino. Debes elegir qué camino seguir en las bifurcaciones estilo OutRun en el camino.

Travel back to the Age of Chivalry when knights were bold, galloping across the countryside and rescuing damsels in distress. This game recreates the time of wizards and the Knights of the Round Table. Lancelot is a three-part interactive fiction adventure, spanning the complete saga from the foundation of the Order to its finest hour - the quest for the Holy Grail. 
Guide Lancelot through his many exploits at Camelot, battle with wayward knights, and win the love of Guinever and Elaine. The challenge which has fascinated treasure hunters through the centuries is now yours - and you´ll need all your strength, wit and valor to achieve your goal. To get the highest possible score, you should only kill combat foes when it is absolutely essential to survival.
The game's command set includes the ability to issue instructions to other knights, and to automatically GO TO a place you have previously visited.
