Strike is a game that allows you to play 10 pin bowling against a friend or a computer player (skill level 1-4). The game follows the rules of bowling where you have to knock down 10 pins at the end of the lane with two shots unless you get a strike on the first throw. You play over 10 rounds and the winner is the player with the highest score. The game has an isometric view showing the player at the start of the lane. 
To throw the ball you first have to position your bowler by moving his feet left or right. When you are happy with your position you press up and hold down the fire button. You release the fire button at the right time as  you approach the line. Let go too soon and you drop the ball and hold on too long and you throw the ball in the air to land on your foot. If you release correctly you see the ball move up the lane and off screen. A box in the top left corner shows the pin positions and the ball hitting them. The bottom right has your scorecard. Once you have had your two shots then the computer or friend throws.  A joystick or keyboard is used to control your bowler.

Puedes recolectar y lanzar hasta 12 hechizos, a los que se accede usando el cursor o las teclas de función (el manual se refiere de manera divertida a que los Amigas tienen teclas F11 y F12, las cuales no las tienen). meta.desc:

Super Pac is an adaptation of the well-loved Pacman arcade hit. New features are different pictures with increasing levels of difficulty, only one super pill and additional bonus.After the title picture has appeared, the game must be started using the fire button. The task is to give the yellow gobball, or Pac for short, enough energy by eating all the drops lying around. However, watch out for the perpetually belligerent ghosts! But you are not defenseless, because there is ONE super pill that makes it possible to devour the attackers. The end of the pill effect can be recognized by the blinking of the ghosts. After successfully completing the meal, you should have caught the floating letters (BONUS) as there are additional bonus points. You should also collect the fruit that appears from time to time, because vitamins are not to be scoffed at. The game can be stopped and started again with the space bar. If you have completed all the pictures, the number of ghosts will increase. (Maximum 7).

meta.name: Super Pipeline II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.31 KB

La secuela de Super Pipeline añade nuevos enemigos y 16 niveles. El jugador controlaba al capataz (de traje blanco) encargado de mantener el flujo de la tubería para llenar varios barriles (que aumentarán en los niveles posteriores, hasta 3). Dos tipos de enemigos se abalanzan sobre la tubería: los que pueden hacer un agujero (comúnmente taladros, un soplete y la jarra de barro) y las plagas (arañas, langostas, etc.). Una vez hecho un agujero en la tubería, el capataz debe guiar a un trabajador (de traje verde) hasta el agujero para que pueda repararlo. Mientras el trabajador repara la fuga, es vulnerable a ser derribado de la tubería.
El capataz está equipado con una pistola para disparar a los enemigos, pero también puede ser derribado por los monstruos. Para complicar aún más las cosas, la langosta solo puede ser atacada por la espalda (debido a su caparazón) y la "Lluvia de Tachuelas" en los niveles posteriores no puede ser disparada.

meta.name: Super Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.29 KB

Much of the design and programming of Superstar Ice Hockey (by many of the same programmers) is revised to provide a six-a-side soccer game. You can control any combination of centre-forward, goalkeeper (on the C64) and manager. For much of the game you are merely the centre-forward as the action unfolds around you - don't be afraid to track back and help out. 
The ball sticks closely to a player, who can pass, shoot, head or bicycle-kick it. Goalkeepers are penalised for retaining possession for too long (a rule later adapted for use in real-life football). Match length can be between 6 and 90 minutes, by toggling the speed at which time moves. Fouls are fully implemented.
Single matches can be played in the cassette version, but the disk version adds a full-season structure. 64 English teams are split into 4 divisions of 16, with a season consisting of either 7 or 15 matches.

meta.name: Super Wonder Boy In Monster Land

Wonder Boy in Monster Land es un juego de plataformas de desplazamiento multidireccional con elementos de RPG, en el que el héroe del juego, Wonder Boy, ha visto cómo su hogar, el país de las maravillas, ha sido invadido por el malvado "Dragón MEKA" y su ejército de secuaces.
Al principio del juego, Wonder Boy está desarmado, pero el gobernador del país de las maravillas (como se conocía antes de la invasión) le da una espada corta para ayudarle en su búsqueda.
Wonder Boy tiene un medidor de vida representado por una serie de corazones rojos y, cada vez que recibe daño, los corazones se reducen. Cuando todos los corazones se agotan, Wonder Boy muere y el juego termina. Además del contador de vida, hay un reloj de arena en la parte superior de la pantalla; cuando se vacía, Wonder Boy pierde algo de vida. El temporizador se puede rellenar recogiendo relojes de arena o visitando hospitales o tabernas.

Como último superviviente de una raza ancestral, tu misión es recoger los sesenta y cuatro fragmentos de pergamino esparcidos por un inmenso complejo subterráneo. Para desplazarte, dispones de un platillo que guías mediante telequinesis. Pero tienes que salir de él para recoger un objeto. Para capturar a los animales, tienes que salir del platillo y dispararles un chorro de anestésico. Tendrás que recargarlo de vez en cuando. ⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 28.98 KB

Eres Espartaco, un gladiador que planea rebelarse contra Roma escapando de la esclavitud y liberando a los demás esclavos de Craso. Sword Slayer es un juego de lucha lateral donde peleas uno a uno con espada y escudo, e incluso te enfrentas a un águila que se abalanza sobre ti.
Tras escapar de la arena, debes defenderte de flechas que llegan a distintas alturas desde la derecha de la pantalla. Tú y tu rival tenéis tres “partes” de energía; cada golpe limpio hace perder una, y al perder las tres es fin de la partida. Un segundo jugador puede controlar a tus oponentes.

meta.name: Swords & Sorcery
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 64.75 KB

The catacombs of Zob are believed to contain untold wealth and fortune, and this is enough to tempt you. That means entering an imposing dungeon filled with strange foes - Mages, Servants of Set, Revenent Guardians and many more. After taking 14 days of training to build up your skills, or taking the default combinations, your magic and swordplay must face the challenge.
Swords and Sorcery is a dungeon-crawler that uses the proprietary MIDAS system to present a first-person visual representation of your position, in a manner similar to Bard's Tale. This is on the left of the screen, with a map of your surroundings on the right, and text messages detailing your current situation below.
Below even that are the menus, which are activated by moving a highlight bar left and right before selecting the correct option. Enemies you meet can be threatened, bribed or grovelled to. You can activate any spells you collect, including un-poison, weaken enemy, and freeze enemy.
Watch out for magical barriers and traps, and use the transporters to your advantage. When you encounter magic would will have to test it to determine its use or detriment.
The Armour of Zob is split into several pieces, which would will hopefully find on your quest. There are also extra swords and shields to collect, plus some treasure as a reward.

Tras la primera noche con su nueva esposa, el Sultán Saladino las mata, y con su poderoso ejército nadie puede detenerlo. Hasta que secuestra a la hermana del Príncipe Imrahil para casarse y la lleva a Bagdad. Tú eres el Príncipe que viaja por ocho niveles esquivando obstáculos, guardias y enemigos hasta rescatarla. Empiezas en un barco cruzando el mar y acabas volando en alfombra mágica para huir.
El juego alterna plataformas (pantalla completa: recoge 6 jugs con letras de "ARABIAN" en orden, sube escaleras/cuerdas, salta plataformas sin caer lejos) y scrolls laterales (balsa esquivando cocodrilos/rocas; alfombras evitando voladores y bichos).
Un jugador, 3 vidas, joystick o teclado.

meta.name: Tchernmisland
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 14.92 KB

Reactor 4 of the TCHERNMISLAND atomic power plant has melted and threatens to explode the entire plant. You must evacuate 25 crates containing valuable documents and materials from the workshop before the final explosion. You can use 3 remote-controlled robots. These robots are very fragile: be careful not to drop them from too high! Be aware that all the rooms in the workshop are occupied by maintenance robots which have received a significant dose of radiation causing them to turn against any visitor. Avoid any contact with them because irradiation above 100 radon will destroy your robot. Fortunately, you can use a sterilization chamber which will reduce your radioactivity level.A helicopter will transport you directly to the reactor core and will wait for you there until the countdown to the explosion ends. Evacuate the boxes via the conveyor belt and return to the helicopter once your task is accomplished.

meta.name: Terror Of The Deep
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.67 KB

In Victorian Scotland there have been sightings of meteorites falling over Loch Ness. Alien life-forms have been spotted coming out of the Loch at night and terrorising the locals and could even be putting The Loch Ness Monster in danger. Something must be done to stop the creatures so you have come across an old Scottish engineer who has designed and built a diving-bell type craft before his death. The diving bell is powered by Water and Seaweed to produce a electric current to power the bell.
As the engineer was old and dying he asked you to pilot the craft and gave you brief instructions on how to use it before he died. You also have managed to get a surface ship to aid you by lowering you into the water, lifting you out and re-supplying you with spears and fuel. Before you dive you must indicate on a map of the Loch to the Captain where you need lowering to kill the alien life-forms.
Once in the murky depths of the dark water you view your surrounding world from a 1st person perspective. You have four windows in front, behind, port side and starboard side which can be looked out but beware as the craft will only go forward. Below the windows is your instrument panel with many instruments on it to keep you alive and complete your mission. Your main gauge to watch out for is your Oxygen and when it gets low (a bell will also warn you) you can use a pump to keep it topped up. A fuel gauge will also let you know your fuel levels.
You are able to move the craft by various devices and levers which enable you to move forward, turn left or right, and lower or raise the craft. A wheel used to turn yourself will also generate power for energy when used. To kill any alien life-forms you have a spear gun which has a limited supply of spears to use. You can fire the spears from any side of the craft as well as lower or raise the gun. If a life-form attaches itself to the craft you can also activate a electric field, they attach if you are stationary and will do damage to the craft. Your last defence is dropping bombs but if you don't operate the plunger when dropping the bombs and you don't get away from the area you will blow yourself up.
If you run out of spears or low on fuel you can sound a klaxon to get the Captain above to send you more down. Once the supplies have reached the bottom you can use your magnet to pick them up. You are able to switch your lights on and off to save energy and your last instrument is a compass. Once you have searched a certain area you can go back up to the ship and search another part of the Loch.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.08 KB

In They Stole a Million you are The Boss, a would-be criminal mastermind out to seek his fortune the dishonest way. To do this you will have to hire a team of criminals, with skills ranging from explosives to driving - these will each seek an upfront payment and a percentage cut of the eventual profits. You will have to buy information and plans on potential targets - an art gallery and bank for example. Menu options reveal pop-up windows of information and sub-menus.
Planning the raid itself is your next task. An overhead view of the site is prevented, with your information on doors and storage locations all readily available. You move each member around the map to give them orders, using a displayed clock to ensure that the action timings overlap correctly. Many options bring up sub-menus of icons.
During the actual crime, you wait outside, with a walkie-talkie to issue orders. Keep an eye out for police cars, as their presence may for you to freeze, or run off with what you have so far. You can enter the site to help out, but this leaves you defenceless if the police arrive.

meta.name: Think!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 18.79 KB

Think! is a strategic puzzle game similar to the board game Connect 4. It's played by two player (player vs. player or player vs. computer) on a 6x6 board. The players take turns in putting out counters on the board and the goal is to get four in a row. The counters can't be placed anywhere, they have to be pushed onto the board from the bottom or the right edge. As a counter is added everything in that row or column will move along. Counters that reach the opposite sides of the board can be pushed off and will then be lost. Winning lines can be horizontal, vertical or diagonal. 
In addition to the normal mode described above there are a few additional variations of it. These are Speed Think! where each player has a limited amount of time to make each move and Blitz Think! where the player have a total time limit for all moves. There's a tutorial mode where the computer gives feedback on how good each move is. At the end the player gets a percentage score. There are also six preset problems with a few counters already on the board. The player can also create his own problems.

Thomas the Tank Engine and Friends para Amstrad CPC es un juego basado en la célebre serie televisiva y los libros infantiles Thomas y sus amigos (creada por Reverend W. Awdry), que narra las aventuras de un tren viviente, Thomas, y sus compañeros. El juego, lanzado en 1992, está diseñado para un público joven y se centra en una experiencia de juego tranquila y educativa, en línea con el espíritu de la serie.
En el juego, el jugador toma el control de Thomas, el tren protagonista, y debe completar varias misiones en la Isla de Sodor, el lugar imaginario donde transcurren las historias. El objetivo principal del juego es ayudar a Thomas y a los otros trenes a cumplir sus tareas diarias, como transportar cargas, recoger vagones y asistir a los otros trenes. El juego no presenta conflictos violentos ni combates, sino que se enfoca en una serie de tareas de gestión y recolección, ideales para un público joven.

Doctor Who references are obvious in this adventure - you play a time travelling hero, who faces a group of Time Lords as they attempt to rewrite human history. To do this, you must collect nine objects which have an hourglass symbol on, from nine different time zones. You will encounter tigers and an Ice Queen in the Ice Age, a guard and a frog in the middle ages, a Cyberman in the future, and more mundane tasks in the present day. Lords of Time is played by typing commands to guide your character, moving in compass directions and with standard commands such as OPEN DOOR, GET GLASS and EXAMINE CAR. Objects you will encounter include keys, an emerald and a petrol can.

Usa tu extintor para sofocar los incendios, y busca a los miembros de la tripulación para liberarlos. Desactiva la gravedad para alcanzar las bombas más problemáticas.

meta.name: Tiny Skweeks
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 119.33 KB

Este juego de puzzle tiene muchos niveles, en los que tienes que guiar a una serie de Brainies (o Tiny Skweeks) de cuatro colores diferentes hasta un punto correspondiente a su color. El reto es que sólo puedes controlar la dirección en la que caminará un Brainy. Una vez establecido esto, seguirá caminando hasta que choque contra una pared, un obstáculo u otro Brainy. Para complicar un poco más las cosas, hay varios obstáculos, como flechas que cambian la dirección en la que camina Brainy y objetos que se pueden recoger. Si se te acaba el tiempo, pierdes una vida.

meta.name: Tir Na Nog
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.33 KB

Tir Na Nog, el primero de una trilogía de títulos de diseño similar de Gargoyle Games, es una mezcla compleja de elementos arcade y de aventuras realizada de una manera innovadora. El juego se ve desde un lado y para cambiar de dirección debes girar la vista.
Juegas como Cuchulainn y debes restaurar la raza Sidhe a su antigua posición de inteligencia, iluminación y civilización. Esto se puede hacer recuperando las cuatro piezas del Sello de Calum, que se hizo añicos cuando el Gran Enemigo invadió.
Muchos acertijos se presentan en forma de mensajes de texto crípticos (mostrados en una elegante fuente pseudocelta), que van desde "encuentra mi corona para un regalo" hasta "La llave de la puerta trasera soy yo"; se requiere pensamiento lateral para interpretar estos mensajes.

meta.name: Titan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 19.43 KB

Titan es un híbrido de arcade y puzle en 2D. En el futuro, el profesor Hybrys diseña este mortal entretenimiento: 80 laberintos donde debes guiar una esfera negra —que se mueve sola, a velocidad constante, en líneas rectas o diagonales— para destruir bloques frágiles o alcanzar la salida.
Controlas una pequeña caja (unidad de control): al posicionarte estratégicamente, la esfera rebota en ella; también puedes atraparla (al pasar rápidamente sobre ella) y lanzarla en la dirección deseada.
Peligros aumentan con el progreso: cráneos (pierdes una de 9 vidas al tocarlos), teletransportadores (intercambian tu posición con la esfera), muros empujables o destructibles, y baldosas que se convierten en paredes si las pisas demasiado.
Mantener pulsada la barra espaciadora reduce la velocidad, útil en situaciones críticas. Combina reflejos rápidos y pensamiento lógico: el reto está en dominar la esfera… indirectamente.

Titantic Blinky es una aventura de plataformas inspirada en Dizzy, pero sustituyendo al huevo protagonista por Blinky, un fantasma algo afeminado y agente secreto de S.P.E.C.T.R.E. Tras el secuestro del profesor Goonhilly por el millonario demente Arthur J. Hackensack —quien demuestra su arma transformando la Isla de Wight en una tarta de natillas, Nueva York en una esponja de baño y la Torre Eiffel en una tostadera—, Blinky se infiltra en el SS Titanic, reflotado como nave base, armado con una pistola ectoplásmica y disfraces.
Como en Dizzy, recoges objetos (bajando el mando) para resolver puzles, pero aquí Blinky tiene munición infinita. Una barra de energía se reduce al tocar enemigos; al agotarse, el fantasma se da la vuelta y pierdes una vida (empiezas con tres). No hay sistema de guardado.

meta.name: Tizpan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.37 KB

You are Tizpan, a regular hero type who just happens to live in a bamboo hut in the jungle in deepest darkest South America. Untouched by outside contact, you survive in domestic bliss with the lovely Jayne, a lady savage. Waking one morning to find that she is gone, and given the signs of struggle it doesn't seem as if it's her choice, you set out to find her and bring her home safely to your hut. A text only adventure written using The Quill utility.

meta.name: Toad Runner
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 27.75 KB

Toadrunner ha sido convertido en sapo por el Stone Master, y debe encontrar a su Princesa para recuperar su forma humana. Puedes llevar hasta cuatro objetos a la vez, cada uno en un bolsillo, pero solo el del cuarto bolsillo se puede usar.

meta.name: Tobrouk 1942
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 92.46 KB

The battle for Tobruk in May-July 1942 was one of the key battles of the North African front in World War 2. Rommel lead the Axis forces to a victory, taking out Allied forces which were gathered to densely mine a strategic defensive area of Libya. In this tactical wargame, players can do the same. Taking the six Allied supply points is crucial to your mission's success.

La moda del "acid" con sus smilies y todo, y la del simpático muñeco que siempre "ta" de algún humor especial, se han unido para formar un juego con el que parece que los señores de Iber quieren dejarse para siempre de Sabrinas y otras zarandajas y demostrar que cuando se quiere programar de verdad se pueden hacer bien las cosas.
La historia comienza cuando nuestro gracioso protagonista, el Toi, se encuentra en una discoteca junto con su novia, Zoi, pasando un rato agradable. Allí aparece el científico loco de costumbre, en este caso el Dr. Acid, quien rapta a la chica de nuestro héroe con la intención de proporcionar divertimento a sus diabólicas creaciones. Nuestro pequeño y orondo amigo no puede dejar que esto ocurra y se lanza al rescate.

Sólo resuenan en tu cabeza las palabras "Tokyo Gang". Todo el resto de tu mente está en blanco. Te encuentras en un mundo tenebroso, donde unos seres extraños van absorbiendo poco a poco toda tu energía. ¡Debes destruirlos!, o morirás en pocos instantes; piensas, mientras recorres este planeta inhóspito, tratando de encontrar el significado de las palabras "Tokyo Gang".
Este juego se desarrolla horizontalmente a una gran velocidad, consta de más de cien pantallas conectadas mediante scroll, divididas en seis fases. Dispones de un nunchaco y de un puñal. Puedes controlar la dirección del salto y usar las armas mientras estás saltando o agachado.

Tom & Jerry es un platformer basado en la icónica pareja de dibujos. Encarnas a Jerry, que debe recorrer cinco niveles recogiendo todo el queso. Además de los obstáculos típicos, hay límite de tiempo y a Tom persiguiéndote. Para evitarlo, puedes usar el entorno: una bola de bolos le deja fuera de combate o un suelo engrasado le hace resbalar.
Los niveles principales son de desplazamiento lateral, pero entre ellos el juego cambia a perspectiva trasera: Jerry corre por un túnel recogiendo queso y esquivando dinamita o bombas.

meta.name: Tomahawk
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 37.65 KB

Los especialistas en simulación de vuelo Digital Integration se centraron en el vuelo de helicópteros con esta recreación del AH-64 Apache. Todos los controles están simulados de forma realista: la velocidad del aire depende de la altura, y puedes moverte horizontalmente con el timón además de inclinarte a izquierda/derecha.
Si usas interfaz de joystick Sinclair, conecta ambos puertos para controles duales como en el real. De cualquier modo, un panel de instrumentos completo permite monitorear todo.
Armado con cañones, cohetes y misiles antitanque (cada uno con targeting independiente, pero solo uno cargado a la vez). Opciones de vuelo: día/noche, despejado/nublado y turbulencia activada/desactivada. Escenario incluye árboles, montañas y postes; enemigos como helicópteros, torretas y tanques.

meta.name: The Tomb Of Kuslak
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.47 KB

For many centuries archaeologists have been searching for the Tomb of Kuslak. Kuslak designed an intricate tomb in which his sarcophagus along with his most treasured possessions would be safe for eternity. By chance you have found the entrance to the Tomb. It may be that you will be the first since the Tomb was sealed from mortal view to see the wonders hidden there. A combination of text adventure and very light RPG, The Tomb of Kuslak sees you stumbling into an ancient tomb seeking your fame and fortune as you search for Kuslak's sarcophagus which houses untold treasures. The game requires text input and features battles with werewolves, skeletons and other nocturnal creatures.

meta.name: Tombstowne
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.11 KB

Tu misión consiste en rescatar las páginas arrancadas de un libro de hechizos del Castillo de Tombstowne, para que el libro completo pueda levantar la maldición que pesa sobre el pueblo. Las páginas son pequeños objetos azules y llamativos que se recogen al «hablarles», momento en el que desaparecen con un destello. Algunas están en lugares de difícil acceso, lo que introduce el elemento aventurero: deberás resolver diversos enigmas. Los escenarios se muestran en 2D, pero puedes atravesar puertas saltando hacia ellas, lo que te traslada a otra sala en ángulo recto. También hay conexiones al salir por los bordes de la pantalla o al subir escaleras saltando a otro nivel. En cada ubicación hallarás muebles (sobre los que puedes saltar), enemigos fantasmales (que debes evitar) y objetos (que puedes recoger).

meta.name: Tomcat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.25 KB

En la primera mitad del siglo XXI, los avances tecnológicos permitieron construir islas artificiales. Una de estas instalaciones militares, ARTROCK 6, se volvió rebelde tras una tormenta violenta, con sus sistemas defensivos controlados por computadora disparando a todo lo que se acerca. Como piloto experto, eres elegido para volar un F-14+2d Tomcat mejorado y destruir esta locura electrónica.
Tomcat es un shooter de desplazamiento vertical visto desde arriba, ambientado en un futuro cercano. Puedes recoger mejoras de armas (más cañones, misiles) de enemigos destruidos.

meta.name: Tomy En El Slalom
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.37 KB

Tomy En El Slalom is a spanish hack of Horace Goes Skiing. Horace Goes Skiing is initially similar to the arcade game “Frogger”. In this instance, Horace has to negotiate a busy and dangerous road, in order to get to the ski shop, to rent a pair of skis. Horace has a starting purse of $40, from which every ambulance fee (when you get hit on the road) costs $10, and the skis themselves will set Horace back $10. Once Horace manages to rent the skis, he has to make his way down the slope, negotiating the flags and not hitting any trees. Once you complete each course, or if you hit a tree, you are sent back to the beginning.

meta.name: Tony Truand
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.48 KB

A French language text adventure. Hi Inspector Fouche! And yes, you are part of the "Big House". Your mission: to get hold of Tony TRUAND. With a name like that, he is not a charming singer but the public enemy #1 that you must find.The great thing about the game is that it takes place in real time and takes you to a wide variety of locations. The graphic illustrations are successful, adding charm to the game. Your clues allow you to establish a robot portrait that appears on the right of the screen. The commands are simple: they are reduced to pressing a key associated with an action. If the police investigation tempts you, here is a game which will occupy you pleasantly!

Toobin' involucra a Biff y Jet compitiendo por rápidos de ríos montados en neumáticos. Rotas tu neumático a izquierda o derecha, y deriva con la corriente evitando orillas y líneas divisorias centrales.
Peligros incluyen cocodrilos, troncos sueltos, ramas y pescadores —estás armado con latas limitadas para eliminarlos. Hay puertas por las que pasar para bonos de puntos. Cada nivel tiene un límite de tiempo estricto, aunque hay una fiesta al final si tienes éxito.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 93.56 KB

Since the news of coup d'etat in the province of Wago arrived, life became completely unbearable. The single resolution to save the peace of the country was to set up a secret organization which would be responsible for liberating the president, who was kidnapped and imprisoned during uprising.
So you enlisted in this secret organization. Manu, one of the members of the organization, is your neighbour. Today, we are in the daytime of July 1st. But, suddenly, Manu has been stopped, and all network is dismantled. It is necessary to recover the equipment, to discover the passage and to drive the plan of Manu to the most complete success. But where to begin, towards whom to go, which persons is it necessary to contact?
Typing in the sentences, you will visit city places including a bank, a bar, a garage, a newsstand, a small public garden, and a graveyard. For this, you have in the top of screen a directory of orders which you can choose with arrows of your keyboard and validate with the key COPY. Choosing an order you complete it with noun and progress in the game.
This text adventure was made in French.

The Tombstone City newspaper appears, reporting that old Marshall Mat Dilion was shot by Billy the Kid. At the same time, a new Marshall is being sought. This job requires a steady hand, a lot of concentration and nerves of steel. Once you have taken on the task, you will see the profile of a man who will appear in front of you shortly afterwards it: She or he. Only one person will leave the street walking upright. They stand opposite each other and wait. Suddenly the villain draws his Colt.
Like him, you also have six bullets in your heavy revolver. You now have to try to hit the opponent. This means pointing the crosshairs at the opponent's head or chest and pulling the trigger. Your opponent initially has a hit rate of 50%, so on average every second shot hits. If you hit your opponent's shooting arm, this percentage drops by 25%, the other arm by 15%, the pants by 20% and the boots at 5'o clock%. If the percentage falls below zero, the opponent is so badly injured that he is completely unable to fight.

This game is based on the Lightcyclerace idea from the Walt Disney film "Tron". Two participants compete against each other with one car each on a limited playing field. After starting, the two cars move in one direction at a constant speed. The player can only determine the direction. Every vehicle pulls a kind of wall behind it that you cannot cross. meta.name: Track Suit Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 127.35 KB

Tracksuit Manager varied the conventional Football Manager game style in a number of ways. You take charge of an international team aiming to qualify for and then play in the European Championships and World Cup. This means there is no transfer market, just a pool of 100 eligible players from which a squad of 22 is selected. You can view reports on each player's ability and form at any stage of the squad and team selection process. You can arrange friendly matches to try out players and ensure that the squad plays together as much as possible.
The matches are presented as a running commentary, with a small graphic indicating which area of the pitch the ball is in. A wide range of tactical options are available to dictate the team's passing style, defensive approach and so on, and in another first you can give specific instructions to individual players (maybe telling a particularly pacy defender to man-mark a dangerous opposition winger instead of staying in a set position).

Traffic is a simple game where the player has to guide cars, motorbikes and buses through busy London streets by changing the traffic lights from red to green. The objective in order to advance to the next level is to get a preset number of vehicles through the screen, although it does not matter which exit you direct them through. Cars continue to queue off the edges of the screen (with numbers next to them if there are queued cars beyond your vision) and if the queue reach more than five cars, it's game over. A warning sound is given when five cars are queued; you must hope there are not also queues on surrounding roads. Cars always stay on their side of the road, and collisions are not possible.

Tu planeta natal está siendo atacado por un aliado que antes era pacífico. La pregunta es si la destrucción violenta puede justificarse en nombre de la paz. Es un shoot 'em up espacial donde en cada nivel debes disparar un número determinado de alienígenas y barreras láser, y bombardear un número concreto de barcos antes de poder aterrizar tu nave.

meta.name: The Trap Door
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 43.79 KB

Berk is trying to obtain a chest of treasure from within a castle inhabited by the Bad Tempered Thing. This involves completing five tasks, although a learner mode in which only 4 are required is also provided. The first task is to provide a can of worms, whilst crushed eyeballs must be provided for task two. You then need to boil Slimies, fry eggs (getting them is a dilemma in itself), and then force everything back into the trapdoor. These tasks must be completed before Thing’s Angry Meter reaches its limit.
As fans of the TV show will recall, the Trap Door of the title seals in numerous strange monsters, and in the game some are harmful and some are a hindrance, depending on the task at hand, so be careful which ones are released. Remember to close it, as spooks will be released if you do not – these require food to be pacified. Boni and Drutt appear regularly – the former giving cryptic morsels of advice, and the latter eating spiders and getting in the way. You can prepare for one task while completing another, so pay attention to items which may be useful, and think about what they are likely to be used in conjunction with.

meta.name: Trashman
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.93 KB

Trashman es un divertido juego de habilidad donde eres un basurero haciendo su trabajo en un barrio británico cualquiera: debes coger los bidones, vaciarlos en el camión que de cuando en cuando avanza calle arriba, y devolverlos vacíos al lugar en el que estaban. Si lo haces bien y no has cometido la torpeza de pisar el césped, los vecinos te saludarán antes de que te marches para invitarte a ver alguna cosa, y si lo haces ganarás un extra de tiempo, ya que, a todo esto, tienes un tiempo limitado para recoger los bidones de toda la calle. Por contra, pisar el césped supone que el contador de tiempo empieza a bajar a toda velocidad hasta que dejas de hacerlo.

Un querrero va a enfrentarse, solo, a los incontables peligros que acechan en el Castillo bajo la Montaña, más alla de donde alcanza la luz del Sol y de donde se atreven a llegar los corazones mas valerosos. La fuerza, la astucia y la habilidad, van a medirse con el hierro, el fuego y la hechicería, en uno de los más tremendos choques entre el Bien y el Mal que el Universo ha presenciado jamás.

meta.name: Le Trésor d'Ali Gator
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.07 KB

You entered an ancient castle, once home of the pirate Ali Gator. According to your information, he has hidden his treasure somewhere here ... Of course, he protected the access against the gravediggers such as you, it is up to you to be smarter than him!
The Treasure of Ali Gator is a three-dimensional role-playing game. Most of the actions, except for moves, are done through menus.

meta.name: The Trial Of Arnold Blackwood
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 15.59 KB

Jobbing detective Arnold Blackwood makes his debut in the first of a series of text-based adventures set in a fictionalised version of the quaint English town of Rochdale. In this installment, Arnold wakes in the grounds of Lord Erebus's estate, but why is he there? He can work out that he would not be there without his Lordship's authority so he must be carrying out a job for the old man... his only hope is to pick up enough clues to figure out what he's supposed to be doing and complete his mission without Erebus catching on that Arnold is not in full control of his own facilities! As you are with him, you might as well give him a helping hand.

meta.name: Triaxos
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.34 KB

Una sonda mental ha sido enviada a la prisión de alta seguridad Triaxos para recuperar información sobre un prisionero que es el único hombre capaz de activar el arma más poderosa de la galaxia. Has aterrizado en la prisión 10 minutos antes que la sonda para encontrar y devolver al hombre a tu nave en 30 minutos. Debes registrar la prisión destruyendo a los guardias robots y explorando cada habitación.
El suelo de cada habitación es antigravedad, por lo que puedes ponerte de pie para usar las otras salidas en cualquier pared. Algunas de las salidas están ocultas, pero el mapa de cada habitación muestra la ubicación de la salida. 
Tendrás que encontrar un Jet-Pack para el prisionero, una llave para controlar las defensas de la prisión y un arma para destruir la sonda mental. También tendrás que localizar la sala de comunicaciones para llamar a tu nave.

meta.name: Tribble Trouble
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 7.39 KB

The Tribbles are continually running around the screen, and you must capture them before they reach a shower unit that will spray deadly acid over them and kill them as a result. There is a cage at the top left of the screen, which you can use to capture the Tribbles one at a time by manoeuvring a set of crosshairs and dragging the cage into the Tribble's path.

meta.name: Trigger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.13 KB

Crazy Park, cuyo nombre ya lo dice casi todo, era un lugar no recomendable para personas que quisieran tener una larga existencia, porque los asesinos, chorizos y demás maleantes lo habían tomado como hogar.
Pero, claro, el perro hay que pasearlo por algún lado y el parque es el más adecuado, siempre que no se te olvide en casa la automática marca Gunstick de mogollón de disparos.
Con ese arma en tus manos tienes alguna posibilidad de sobrevivir a un "tranquilo" paseo por el parque; eso sí, poniendo a prueba tu carnet de tirador de élite que tus buenos duros te costó.

meta.name: Trik Trak
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.04 KB

White moves his pieces against the clock, starting at the bottom left of the screen and attempting to reach the top left as soon as possible. Black moves his pieces the other way round.	Once a player has all his pieces in the last quarter of the board, he can remove them. To do this he needs to throw enough to pass the outer limit of the board (or more).	The player who removes all his pieces from the board is the winner.

meta.name: Triple Comando
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 42.20 KB

Un gobierno sudamericano, tras largas gestiones y una gran actividad de espionaje ha conseguido hacerse con el TECNOLOGY POSITRONIC, un cañón fotónico de gran envergadura cuya potencia es superior a todo lo conocido. EL POSITRONIC codiciado por muchos otros países, pone en peligro la tensa paz que se vive en la zona.
La única solución es destruirlo a cualquier precio y para ello se ha contratado a un veterano del Vietnam, Charlie Montinni, experto en armamento y feroz luchador. Sus compañeros Humphrey Stallone y Billy Von Pettet le ayudarán en tan arriesgada misión. En TRIPLE COMANDO tú puedes ser cualquiera de ellos y adentrarte en la jungla en busca del temible cañón.

meta.name: The Tripods
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 24.45 KB

The Tripods es un juego futurista en el que el mundo ha sido invadido por una raza alienígena conocida como los Trípodes y los humanos están encerrados en un dispositivo de control del pensamiento. Un grupo de adolescentes que intentan evitar ser capados a los dieciséis años se da a la fuga, en busca de las Montañas Blancas que, según cuentan, representan la resistencia humana contra los Trípodes. Esto les lleva de Inglaterra a Francia, donde se encuentran las montañas.
Los jugadores seleccionan una acción pulsando la tecla correspondiente. En la parte inferior de la pantalla, debajo de los gráficos, aparecen descripciones en texto de las acciones y de la situación.

meta.name: Trivia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 50.16 KB

Trivia is a computer quiz game based on the board game Trivial Pursuit where you have to move around a board answering questions on 6 subjects on various small squares. The categories are Entertainment, History, Sport & Leisure, Geography, Arts & Literature and Science & Nature and each subject is colour coded. The aim is to collect six pieces before your opponents, one from each subject by answering a question correctly on a large square for each category. The squares go round the edge of the board and you can move either left or right. A dice is thrown to see how many squares you can move and if you answer correctly then you move again, the next player moves if you answer incorrectly. You have to say the answer out loud and tell the computer if the answer was right or wrong. There is no single player option.

meta.name: Trivial Pursuit : Genus Edition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.46 KB

This is the earliest home computer incarnation of Horn Abbot International Ltd's classic board game, Trivial Pursuit. The game involves answering questions on one of six subject categories to gain moves, and answering questions on special squares to gain one of the six 'Wedges' you need to gain the right to take on the final winning question. Questions are aimed at British players - many entertainment questions are based on British TV, and sport questions relate to popular British sports.
Two game modes are available:- single player (which involves answering questions against the clock) and multiplayer (where you can take on up to five human-controlled players). The computer reveals the answer, and you select 'yes' or 'no' to tell it whether you got it right.
The question categories are exactly the same as the board game, however two different question styles are added to take advantage of computer technology - some questions relate to a picture or diagram and some relate to a piece of music. 
One additional feature not available in the board game is a statistical analysis of the number and type of questions answered correctly. This can be split into the performances of all the players, or the performance of an individual player within the six categories. It is especially useful at the end of the game, when choosing which category a player must answer to win the game.

meta.name: Trivial Pursuit : A New Beginning
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 29.32 KB

Esta secuela difiere del primer opus, que retomaba el principio original del famoso juego de tablero. Cada jugador controla ahora una nave espacial y el objetivo general es convencer a los Sabios del planeta Genus de que acepten el plan de colonización de tu pueblo.
Todos los Sabios se encuentran en diferentes partes de la galaxia y sólo se puede llegar a ellos viajando por la galaxia respondiendo correctamente a las preguntas y respondiendo a una pregunta específica una vez que se ha llegado a ellos.
Las seis categorías de preguntas son las mismas que en el juego original, y hay 50 niveles de preguntas que resolver, pero la gran diferencia es que la categoría de pregunta es aleatoria.

meta.name: Trivial Pursuit : Nouvelle Generation
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 127.34 KB

Esta secuela difiere del primer opus, que retomaba el principio original del famoso juego de tablero. Cada jugador controla ahora una nave espacial y el objetivo general es convencer a los Sabios del planeta Genus de que acepten el plan de colonización de tu pueblo.
Todos los Sabios se encuentran en diferentes partes de la galaxia y sólo se puede llegar a ellos viajando por la galaxia respondiendo correctamente a las preguntas y respondiendo a una pregunta específica una vez que se ha llegado a ellos.
Las seis categorías de preguntas son las mismas que en el juego original, y hay 50 niveles de preguntas que resolver, pero la gran diferencia es que la categoría de pregunta es aleatoria.

Humgruffin el troll ha sido transportado a un mundo misterioso llamado Narc, una extraña tierra de cavernas de cristal habitada por goblins. Su única forma de escapar es recolectar cristales.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 22.15 KB

Estás comprando en tu supermercado local donde debes adquirir 40 artículos de tu lista. El problema es que hacer la compra aquí es peligroso, con criaturas merodeando y obstáculos en tu camino. Puedes perder una de tus cuatro vidas al tocar una criatura, caer desde altura o chocar con ciertos obstáculos.

This game was published in Micro Mag n ° 13 (June 1990).
A snake remodeled, one of the great classics that made the joy of your childhood.
You play against the computer in a 58x48 square-sized play area.
You are blue and your opponent is red. Needless to say, the party stops when one of you touches other one, or a track, a wall, an obstacle, etc. Changing the level is ensured by obtaining a sufficient score.
Three levels and each consisting of five tables that are offered to your skill (one advice, try to block the enemy in his own tracks).

meta.name: Trouble In Space
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.17 KB

The Milky Way, the systems of the hyperspace created in 2083 have become disorganized as a result of a comet's movement. However, since these hyperspace routes are among the most important trade routes for humanity, a brave pilot is sent to these remote areas to restore order. You naturally take on the role of the daring astronaut. Your task is to make the hyperspace route navigable again. By clicking on the fields surrounding the free space, you influence the movement of your spherical ship. The goal is now to leave the playing field with the space cruiser at the point marked with an arrow on the left. There are also many undiscovered celestial bodies to be found on the edge of the hyperspace route that can top up the player's points account. Time is also your enemy. The faster you complete a new hyperspace route, the more points you get.

Cada carrera consta de hasta otras 15 motos y, como se trata de una simulación, también se incluyen paradas en boxes para repostar combustible y cambiar neumáticos.

meta.name: Turbo Out Run
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 117.46 KB

La secuela de OutRun presenta una jugabilidad básica similar a la original, con la acción vista desde detrás del automóvil y el desafío es completar cada etapa dentro del límite de tiempo. El contacto puede hacer que el automóvil gire, disminuya la velocidad o incluso se voltee; en cada caso perderás tiempo.
Hay 16 escenarios ubicados en los EE. UU., moviéndose gradualmente de este a oeste, todos representados visualmente de manera diferente. Después de cada 4 niveles, ingresa a una pantalla de tienda, con una selección de actualizaciones. Como lo indica el título, ahora tiene instalado un turbo booster, que acelera el automóvil, aunque el uso excesivo puede hacer que el motor se sobrecaliente, y no se recarga hasta cada sección de la tienda. Tienes 5 continuaciones, y no completar el curso dentro del límite de tiempo te cuesta una.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 118.19 KB

Turrican II: The Final Fight es un juego de plataformas y disparos del tipo que se suele ver en las consolas, pero diseñado desde cero para ordenadores personales.
Su argumento es sencillo: un malvado mega-robot llamado "la Máquina" ataca la nave Avalon 1 de los Planetas Unidos, masacrando a todos los que se resisten. Todos excepto Bren McGuire, que consigue escapar y ponerse la armadura biónica experimental de Turrican. Como Turrican, se propone demostrar a la Máquina quién manda.
A diferencia de otros juegos de este tipo, este juego contiene tres niveles de acción de tiro horizontal. Hay seis grandes mundos para explorar, en los que eres bastante libre de ir donde quieras, ya que no hay desplazamiento automático y los niveles están llenos de vidas extra y armas ocultas. Todos estos niveles son muy diferentes: el primero, en el desierto de piedra, es muy colorido, mientras que los siguientes mundos son cada vez más oscuros.

meta.name: Turris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.37 KB

Turris offers brain-massaging strategy in its purest form. The towers are built on a 6x6 square game board. With each move, the builder places a floor on a square that is still free or has already been built on. Depending on the number of their direct neighbors, the different squares can "take" towers of different heights: A tower on a corner square collapses when it is 2 high. Squares on one of the edges of the game board start to shake at a height of 3, and all other squares collapse at a height of 4. When a tower collapses, it distributes its "floors" evenly to the surrounding fields. These then become the property of the person who owned the "exploded" tower. Floors that were already on the "newly conquered" fields - regardless of who owned them - also become the property of the "conqueror". In this way, unexpected chain reactions can occur, which is what makes the game so exciting. The winner is the person who can drive the opponent off the field with their towers.

meta.name: Tusker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 77.31 KB

Encontrar el misterioso Cementerio del Elefante en África fue la búsqueda de toda la vida de tu Padre. Cuando desaparece, estás decidido a descubrir lo que pudo haberle sucedido, y qué secretos pueden estar dentro.
Esta aventura de arcade de desplazamiento lateral se divide en tres etapas, atravesando el duro y estéril desierto, una red subterránea de cuevas, y una selva salvaje. Los nativos son hostiles a tu presencia, y debes encontrar distintas armas para defenderte de ellos, aunque al principio no te lo pondrán nada fácil para usarlas. El machete a parte de como arma, es igualmente importante para atravesar la selva. En muchos otros puntos necesitarás usar objetos que hayas encontrado en el camino. Los fondos están en 3D completo y pueden servir para oscurecer al personaje cuando estás detrás de árboles o rocas.

Tut's Pyramid is a clone of the CPC classic Sorcery.
Your name is Mohamed, and with your flying carpet, off you must venture, searching for six stone blocks. Placing these in the Valley of the Kings forms a mini-pyramid and will save the Pharaoh's life.

meta.name: Twice Shy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 48.03 KB

Twice Shy is a thriller written by Dick Francis and published in 1981. 
This game is a text based adventure that puts you in the role of Jonathan Derry, a physics teacher in a comprehensive school in the south of England. 
Dick Francis is famed for his complex thrillers based around the English horse racing scene and this game is based around one of his classics. Without giving too much of the plot away, the story is based around some Spectrum software cassettes, horse racing and the bad guys who want them. 
As well as the adventure game itself there is a racing game which can be run either independently as a free-standing game, or part of the adventure, when the game requires the player to go to a race-course to look for clues.

Controlas el coche con dirección, acelerador/freno y puedes cambiar entre dos marchas: baja y alta. Debes llegar a los marcadores de etapa dentro del límite de tiempo para continuar. Se otorgan bonos de tiempo según tu rendimiento.

meta.name: Twins
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.65 KB

Twins es un shoot-'em-up directo y emocionante: a bordo de tu nave, debes liberar a tu hermano secuestrado por Darkson, un tirano intergaláctico. Para lograrlo, atraviesas oleadas de naves enemigas —drones, cazas blindados, naves nodrizas— que sirven al villano con lealtad implacable. El combate es intenso: disparos, esquives y maniobras en espacio reducido mientras recoges mejoras (láseres gemelos, escudos, misiles homing). Cada fase culmina en un duelo contra un jefe único, con patrones exigentes y puntos débiles ocultos. La narrativa, mínima pero efectiva, se transmite mediante breves pantallas entre niveles: mensajes de tu hermano, datos de inteligencia, advertencias de Darkson. Un homenaje a los clásicos arcade de los 80/90, con ritmo acelerado, diseño limpio y una motivación clara: no es solo salvar al mundo… es salvar a tu hermano.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.80 KB

Une affaire en or (a golden opportunity, or something like that) is a business simulation for up to four players. You are the new director of the "Apples Company", and your goal is to turn the company into Europe's biggest player in the apple compote industry.
You start out with a capital of 15 million francs, for which you must buy factory capacity, energy, apples and hire a workforce. You have four different energy alternatives, ranging from atom energy to coal, petrol or gas. Atom energy is expensive but secure, whereas your energy supply can get interrupted by wars in the Middle East if you rely on petrol, and the other alternatives also fluctuate in price and supply. After having bought energy and supplies, you can start production. Your production capacity per turn is calculated based on the size of your factory in relation to your labour force. Being a French labour force, strikes can halt production for certain turns, and mood swings will bring down productivity as well.
Production cannot proceed without a supply of apples, and accidents in your warehouse may force you into the market to buy fresh ingredients. Apples can be bought in your own region, from all of France, or from the EEC market. Supply is limited, and may be brought down by bad weather. 
For selling your stock, you need a dealer network, either on a national or European level. The market prices fluctuate, and can be saturated by cheap "made in Hong-Kong" goods, halting trading for one turn or more. Sometimes, the state will cease your stock and pay only half price for it. However, the state also tends to give you subsidies for investments.
The game is won by saturating the markets, both domestic and export. Gameplay takes place on a screen filled with graphs and a cursor-based menu, triggering action dialogues. Five actions can be taken per turn, and each turn is ended by entering the production phase.

Video Card Arcade allows you to play three different card games in arcade form to win as much money as you can with a certain amount of credits. The three games are Poker Royal, Twenty One and High Low. 
Poker Royal: Based on Five Card Poker, you are dealt five cards and you must decide which cards to hold and which cards to dispose off, trying to get the best hand. For example, if you dispose two cards then you get two new ones. You then see if you have won any money based on what hands you now have. 
Twenty One: Based on the game Pontoon you play against the dealer trying to get a higher hand without going over 21. You and the dealer are dealt two cards and you can decide whether to keep them or to receive another card. You can keep receiving until you are happy with your score and then it's the dealer's turn. The winner is the player with the highest score, if you have higher than 21 then you are bust and lose.
High Low: You are dealt five cards and you can only see the first one. Here you can decide whether to keep or change it. Now you have to decide if the next card is higher or lower. If you guess correct it's onto the next card, guess wrong then you have to start with five new cards. If the next card is the same then it is determined by what suit it is. When you manage to get all five cards turned over, your winnings are based on what hands you have.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 45.46 KB

Vigilante es un beat-em-up de desplazamiento lateral. Presenta a un duro personaje que recorre las calles para luchar contra la banda de los Rogues, que han secuestrado a su novia María. El juego cuenta con cinco localizaciones distintas, como calles de la ciudad y un vertedero, con numerosos matones de diferentes características. Se lucha con los puños, los pies y la cadena, realizando ataques de pie, agachado y saltando. Cada nivel tiene un jefe final que requiere tácticas específicas. Los enemigos aparecen continuamente por los lados izquierdo y derecho de la pantalla hasta llegar al jefe. Esto significa que tienes que moverte a un ritmo rápido para llegar al final del nivel antes de que se agote el tiempo. Cuando los enemigos se acercan demasiado, agarran al personaje y es necesario pulsar rápidamente a izquierda y derecha para liberarlo, ya que entonces es vulnerable a los ataques.

The rooms are drawn in an isometric perspective, and while the graphics are not too bad, some terrible choices of colours are used in a lot of the rooms. Once you've located the sphere, you then play a simple 3D shoot-'em-up with enemy spacecraft heading towards you.

meta.name: Wacky Darts
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 36.35 KB

The bar room game of darts involves aiming small projectiles at a circular board. The board is divided into 20 shapes around the edge, each of which has a value from 1 to 20 points, a special double area around the edge and a special treble area in the middle (each of which multiply the shot score). There is also a bullseye right in the middle for 50 points and an outer bull around it, worth 25 points.
Players always take three shots at a time. In the 501 game the aim is to reduce the score from 501 to 0, finishing with a double or the bull. If the score reaches 1 or a negative number, any shots in that set of 3 are cancelled out. In Round The Board, the player must hit each target in turn starting with 20, but moving back 2 or 3 for a double or treble, eventually finishing with Double Top.

You've got to catch the falling fruit in your basket.For each fruit you score 10 points, and after each 100 points you get a chance at the next screen. Watch out for the deadly perils that may befall you. You've only got until the bird reaches his nest to collect enough fruit. Level one is easy but to start on a harder screen press keys 1-6 while in the DEMO mode. Joystick only.

meta.name: Wacky Races

Asumes el papel de Dastardly y Mutley de la serie de dibujos animados de Hanna-Barbera en este título de acción con matices superficiales de carreras. Tu objetivo es completar cada recorrido en una posición determinada, lo que se consigue esperando a que sufran suficiente daño como para abandonar la carrera o infligiendo ese daño tú mismo. Tu auto está armado con una flecha que dispara hacia adelante para empalar a los autos de la oposición y lidiar con los muchos peligros que te presentan las carreras, incluidas rocas y conejos, que puedes eliminar para ganar puntos.

meta.name: W.A.R.
meta.desc:

Una enorme cadena de cilindros se dirige a la Tierra para conquistarnos desde una raza alienígena avanzada y belicosa. Dentro de cada cilindro hay ciudades, campos, fábricas, centrales eléctricas y bases militares, todo lo que una fuerza invasora necesita para colonizar otro planeta. Varios intentos por destruir esta cadena han fallado, hasta ahora. Eres la última esperanza de la Tierra mientras pilotas tu nave sobre la superficie de los cilindros para detenerlos, pero los Droidanos patrullan los cilindros e intentarán destruirte a lo largo de ocho niveles. Estás armado con un cañón y puedes disparar o esquivar las oleadas de Droidanos, pero si te golpean, pierdes una de tus cinco vidas.
Aunque se promocionó con la versión de Commodore 64, este es simplemente un shooter vertical donde la pantalla se desplaza constantemente hacia arriba, en lugar de jugar como un clon de Uridium. Puedes usar joystick o teclado para controlar tu nave.

Each car has five lives and if you crash into the other car then you lose one of five lives. The game keeps going, letting you build up a score and it only ends when all lives are lost.

War in Middle Earth on 8-bit machines is a simpler version of the 16-bit game. It doesn't feature the questing and RPG aspects of the other title and is instead a pure strategy game. The player controls the forces of good in the War of the Ring from J.R.R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings. The game begins with the Fellowship of the Ring just having formed in Rivendell and the hobbit Frodo Baggins carrying the One Ring. The ultimate goal of the game is to get the ring bearer to the cracks of Mount Doom to destroy the ring. The game is lost if the ring bearer is killed or corrupted by the ring's influence or if Sauron's forces capture the city of Minas Tirith. The game takes place in three different views. The Middle Earth Map displays the whole of the land on one screen, with the player's armies highlighted (unlike the 16-bit versions, enemy armies cannot be seen until encountered). A more detailed view is available in the Campaign Map. This displays much more detail of the land, showing rivers, roads, forests, mountains, towns, et cetera. Units are displayed as shield icons, representing either individual characters or larger military formations. If combat occurs, the Battle Screen is employed, which shows every individual soldier.

In the middle of the first century, the Romans were sweeping across Britain, defeating the various tribes and taking control of the island. The further North they got, the harder it became until they reached the border between England and Scotland and were halted in their tracks. No matter how hard they tried they just couldn't defeat the Scottish tribes led by a Northern warlord. As the fighting intensified, the Gods of both sides got involved until the ferocity of the armies and the Gods was so intense that the end of the world was imminent. A truce was called between the Gods and the solution was to take a champion from each side and transport them both to a Celtic Otherworld. The aim now was for each champion to attempt to get back to the real world before the other one to be declared the winner. You as the Warlord was chosen for the Celts, while a centurion for the Romans was picked to try to beat you back.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 67.35 KB

Welltris, which is the first Tetris sequel, is originally designed by Alexey Pajitnov (the creator of Tetris) with Andrei Sgenov.
It has the same gameplay concept as Tetris; simply all the player has to do is to rotate and maneuver the falling pieces into a proper position in order to form complete layers in the rectangular playground. But Welltris changes this rectangular arena into a four sided well with grid-like walls and bottom where the falling pieces can be moved from wall to wall within the well. Form the pieces into solid rows either horizontally or vertically on the bottom of the well.
Billed itself as Tetris in three dimensions.

meta.name: Wembley Greyhounds
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 17.89 KB

Wembley Greyhounds is a betting game that allows one to three players to bet on various dog races over a season on various courses. As money is won or lost on each race, a scoreboard is used to show the progress of each player with the aim to finish top at the end of the season. Each dog that wins goes through to Wembley to compete to be champion dog.
Before a race, each player has various options like looking at tables and stats, but the main options allow the players to bet. There are two types of bookies to be chosen and they are a choice of four bookies to select or the course bookie. As decisions are made, a timer counts down to the race and the odds of the dogs keep changing. There are three types of bets that can be made and they are win only, the first two dogs in the correct order, and the first two dogs in any order. A maximum of £50 can be bet with and once all the bets have been made then its onto the actual race.  
The race can be watched with the various dogs swapping positions as the race progresses chasing a hare and when the race has finished then the race result is shown. The Wembley qualifiers are shown before the scoreboard for the players is shown.

El objetivo del juego es deshacerte de la maldición licantrópica, lanzada por los restantes miembros de tu familia, asesinando a todos y cada uno de ellos. Cada vez que te encuentres en tu camino delante de uno de tus enemigos una cruz parpadeará en tu fila de icono. ¡Persigue y destruye! Si tienes éxito, cada cruz será tuya, y te librarás de la maldición cuando hayas recogido y guardado ocho de estas cruces.
Deberás encontrar víctimas que tengan objetos que te sean útiles, como billetes de metro, o llaves para la cárcel o el aparcamiento. La antorcha te ayudará a ver cuando te encuentres en las cloacas o en los subterráneos del metro y un ascensor te ayudará a subir a los sitios de difícil acceso. La lima te servirá para salir de la cárcel, y para curarte las heridas podrás usar vendas.
Si eres listo puedes esconder los objetos que te puedan servir para salir de la cárcel durante el día, para que así puedas usarlos más tarde. Prolongar tu hora de la comida al máximo es el objetivo principal del juego... ¡Buena caza!

meta.name: Western Games
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 73.21 KB

Western Games has six Wild West themed sport-style events. In Arm Wrestling you must pull the joystick back when the arm in the central display has entered a strong phase and press the button to prop the arm up then hope for the best. 
The Beershooting event requires you to shoot a 5 beer glass targets faster than your opponent, but this is not too easy if you get nervous.Player 1 moves the joystick to the right to draw their gun, while Player 2 must move theirs to the left. Once the gun is drawn, the crosshairs are used to line up the target. Press the joystick button to fire. A beating heart shows the degree of your nervousness in the display. 
Quid-spitting requires that you bite off the right amount of tobacco and chew it to just the right consistency before you determine what angle to spit it into the pot. This requires some fancy joystick handling. To lift your arm and bite off the quid, you must move the joystick forward.To chew, you must move the joystick fast to the left and right. Don't chew it too long or too short. To stop chewing, you must move the joystick forward. Once that is done you must pull the stick back to determine the strength. Click and hold the joystick button to determine the right angle. Press the joystick button to spit. Timing is the key. 
The Milking event has a rhythmically heaving udder indicating the beat that you must move the joystick. To fill the cans, the joystick must be moved in a predetermined pattern, but it must be moved rythmically with the udder. You can elbow your opponent to get the upper hand by moving your joystick to the right and pressing the joystick button. 
Dancing requires a complicated routine of joystick movements to do certain dance moves while keeping the beat. Lose the beat and the other guys bash the piano player on the head causing him to stop playing. You must buy the piano player another beer to have him resume playing. 
The Eating competition is the final event. Dip the spoon into the stew. Balance the spoon. Slurp. Chew. Swallow. and drink. Simple? No. If you get some out of order, you get delayed by belching. Dip the spoon by moving the joystick back. Balance the spoon by moving the joystick to the left and right.; Once leveled, slurp. Chew by again moving the joystick to the right and left. To swallow, pull the joystick back and press the joystick button. Finish it off with a drink before you dip the spoon in again, by moving the joystick forward.

Western Games has six Wild West themed sport-style events. In Arm Wrestling you must pull the joystick back when the arm in the central display has entered a strong phase and press the button to prop the arm up then hope for the best. 
The Beershooting event requires you to shoot a 5 beer glass targets faster than your opponent, but this is not too easy if you get nervous.Player 1 moves the joystick to the right to draw their gun, while Player 2 must move theirs to the left. Once the gun is drawn, the crosshairs are used to line up the target. Press the joystick button to fire. A beating heart shows the degree of your nervousness in the display. 
Quid-spitting requires that you bite off the right amount of tobacco and chew it to just the right consistency before you determine what angle to spit it into the pot. This requires some fancy joystick handling. To lift your arm and bite off the quid, you must move the joystick forward.To chew, you must move the joystick fast to the left and right. Don't chew it too long or too short. To stop chewing, you must move the joystick forward. Once that is done you must pull the stick back to determine the strength. Click and hold the joystick button to determine the right angle. Press the joystick button to spit. Timing is the key. 
The Milking event has a rhythmically heaving udder indicating the beat that you must move the joystick. To fill the cans, the joystick must be moved in a predetermined pattern, but it must be moved rythmically with the udder. You can elbow your opponent to get the upper hand by moving your joystick to the right and pressing the joystick button. 
Dancing requires a complicated routine of joystick movements to do certain dance moves while keeping the beat. Lose the beat and the other guys bash the piano player on the head causing him to stop playing. You must buy the piano player another beer to have him resume playing. 
The Eating competition is the final event. Dip the spoon into the stew. Balance the spoon. Slurp. Chew. Swallow. and drink. Simple? No. If you get some out of order, you get delayed by belching. Dip the spoon by moving the joystick back. Balance the spoon by moving the joystick to the left and right.; Once leveled, slurp. Chew by again moving the joystick to the right and left. To swallow, pull the joystick back and press the joystick button. Finish it off with a drink before you dip the spoon in again, by moving the joystick forward.

meta.name: World Championship Boxing Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 86.39 KB

In World Championship Boxing Manager the player can develop the careers of aspiring heavyweight boxers. The option are selected through an icon-based system, representing the manager's office.
Training the boxers involves deciding which areas they should work on, considering their strengths and weaknesses and any damage inflicted in previous fights, and those of their next opponent. There are 97 of these in the game, so reaching the top of the rankings will take about 15-20 fights. Choosing a beatable opponent who can get the fight as high up the Friday Night bill as possible, as well as negotiating the best financial deal and a mutually agreeable dare, are the main considerations.
Two different governing bodies are included in the game, each with subtly different rules. A fight in one set of rules won't be viewed quite as significantly by the other.
The matches are presented from the commentary box, with the two expert analysts exchanging textual descriptions of the key punches, and who is dong the best (a clue to how any judges? decision would go). Before and during the fights the player can instruct the boxer as to what tactics to adopt.

This soccer game lets you choose a team representing one of twenty-four countries around the world to participate in the World Championship tournament, which is identical to the real 1990 World Cup.

meta.name: World Class Leader Board
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.11 KB

Before the long-running Links series, Access produced the Leader Board lineage, which concludes here. Wind, snap and power are the main considerations as you dodge the bunkers, water and rough which make for more complex courses than the 8-bit versions of the original.
A course editor is provided.  The courses provided include real courses like St. Andrews, a fictional designs such as The Gauntlet, which as the name suggests is designed to push your skills to the maximum.
The PC version revolutionized the use of the PC speaker to reproduce voice samples via their patented "RealSound" process. Quips like "No doubt about it, he's deep in the sandtrap", "Straight onto the fairway", and "Looks like he hit the tree, Jim." are used to provide running commentary on the gameplay.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.42 KB

World Soccer is a managerial soccer simulation in which the player is responsible for the financial and athletic success of a soccer team. The world soccer league is the home of the best teams of Europe and the player takes over a team from the 3rd division; the goal being to become the number one in the long run. 
The game is mostly menu based in which the player can visit the medical station, the transfer market (available athletes are searched by a scout), the bank for a loan and of course the lineup for the next match. Each athlete has a few statistics which should be taken into account.
During the matches the player can't intervene besides substitutions in the half-time. The player can watch the highlights of the match; either with animations in the 16-bit versions or as text in the 8-bit version. Alternatively only the results can be shown.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.35 KB

In this Snake game, a maximum of 4 players can compete each other. Each player has 3 lives at the beginning. If you now move around with your worm and hit an obstacle or an opponent, your worm will become shorter. If an opponent causes the shortening, he will receive points accordingly. You can also collect various extras in the game. If you pick up a green pill, your worm will become longer. If you pick up a question mark, you will receive either a worm extension, a speed change or a bonus of 50 points. If there is only one player left in the race, the speed will automatically increase after a short time. This is why this game is actually only suitable for several players. The player who has the most points at the end wins.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 31.14 KB

The setting is ancient Greece. You are one of the gods of Greek mythology who has incurred the wrath of the all-powerful god Zeus. As a punishment, Zeus has cast a curse of forgetfulness upon you, and now you don't even know who you are. The only way to restore your memory is to enter the realm of Hades and drink the water from the Pool of Remembrance.

meta.name: Wreckless Roger
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 13.92 KB

Wreckless Roger is a side-view flick screen shooter where you play the role of Roger who after landing on an inhospitable planet, has discovered his spacecraft, the Millenium Sparrow, has been dismembered. The pieces of the craft have been scattered all over a cavern and so you must fly Roger around the cavern using his jet-pack, and armed with his laser to blast all the aliens in his search for the pieces. The cavern is made up of a teleport maze and to move from screen to screen, you must destroy all the aliens so that arrows appear in the side of the screen, showing where you can move next. On some screens, an exit appears in the centre of the screen but it can only be used when you hold a piece of the craft. If you are hit by any alien then Roger loses part of his power and when it reaches zero then you lose one of three lives.

meta.name: Wriggler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 30.36 KB

One of the few games to set you as a maggot, in Wriggler you must negotiate the four stages of the Maggot Marathon. This involves trekking through a garden, a shrubbery, an underground lair, and finally a mansion. 
Viewed form above the game is maze-based, with lots of Atic Atac style sections where you can see other parts of the level on the same screen, but can't access them because the design of the maze puts something in the way. Graphics are quite large and chunky - this is perhaps the closest anyone came to borrowing Rapscallion's unusual visual design.
You have an energy bar which decreases constantly, and contact with the ants, spiders and the rest of the sickly creatures reduces this further. Fortunately you can obtain apples, cherries, cups of tea (I suspect a generation of sadistic 10-year-olds started trying to ply worms with caffeine as a result of this) and other foodstuffs to recharge this. These can be eaten immediately or stored for later use, however you can only hold one object at a time. Many other items are needed to get past situations during the game, so be careful what you keep to avoid too much backtracking through the 256 screens.

The game is played over three phases. The player commands a destroyer and in the first phase they must patrol the Atlantic protecting convoys from submarine attack. Xanagams is a single player educational word game that is something like a cross between cross-words and scrabble.
The game consists of a series of interlinked words in a crossword style grid. The player is supplied with all the letters that comprise these words and the object of the game is to place the letters correctly onto the play area to complete the words. Points are awarded for correctly placing a letter and are lost for either placing a letter incorrectly or asking the game to reveal what the correct letter in a given location is.
There are three levels of difficulty which are said to be for 'junior school children', 'senior school children' and 'adults and brighter children', and a game can consist of 1 - 5 words.

Gameplay has several elements, with the first task being to locate a Sentinel and guide your ship to it. Two inbuilt computers can be used to help you with this. Next you must land on the planet's surface, avoiding contact with anything as you head for the ground.
The main bulk of the game sees you walk around the planet's surface, destroying all the alien craft you can find. These include dark creatures such as Tri-Syncs and Mirobs.

Xeno is a future sport resembling Air Hockey. Each of the two players (the second being either human or computer controlled) controls a ground skimmer, which is aiming to hit a puck so as to knock it into their opponent's goal. meta.name: Yahtzee
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 10.46 KB

Yahtzee is an implementation of the popular dice game. Players take turns rolling 5 dice, and the player can reroll any or all of the dice twice more before selecting their scoring category. Scoring categories include 6 categories within the Upper Section, which include the sum of all ones to sixes. If the sum of the upper category is 63 points or more, the player receives a 35 point bonus. In the Lower Section, the categories include 3 of a kind, 4 of a kind, full house, a 4 dice straight, a 5 dice straight, yahtzee (5 of a kind) and chance (which is the sum of all dice). A game is finished when all 11 scoring categories have been used.

meta.name: Yes Prime Minister
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.49 KB

A week in the life of the British Prime Minister.  But not just any Prime Minister, this game puts you in the shoes of Prime Minister James (Jim) Hacker from the classic BBC television comedy "Yes, Prime Minister".  
Much like most political simulations, you must balance your popularity with the needs of your party, the meddling of foreign governments, and the small minded incompetence of the civil servants that surround you.  All of this is played out with multiple choice dialogues between Hacker and the other cast members of the series (complete with lo-res digital pictures).  The dry humor of the show abounds as you must deal with crises such as the French refusing to continue work on the channel tunnel until Waterloo station is renamed.  Fans of the show will recognize much of the material and non-fans should still find enough laughs to keep them interested.

All characters can move around the house, pick up and drop objects, as well as break and fix things. The characters often talk, giving the player clues as to what the character is intended to do. The aim of the game is to try and move out of the house with all the character's belongings in the shortest time possible. This is not so easy, because these possessions are typically not in their preferred condition, or are hidden around the house, and players need various tools to get to them. The other characters will move around the house, behaving in-character, occasionally moving around or further damaging the possessions - making the task harder.

meta.name: Zap 't' Balls
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 32.42 KB

Zap't'Balls is most notable for its technical novelties. Amstrad experts would think it was running on a Plus, as what appear to be hardware sprites are moving smoothly at full speed. However, this was accomplished on a stock CPC by forming a stack within video RAM itself, a technique achieved by disabling interrupts.
The game itself is similar to Pang. One or two players have 80 screens of balls to clear, by firing a rope vertically such that a ball will hit it. Upon doing this it splits into two balls of half the size, unless it is at the smallest size, when it will disappear. Each screen must be cleared within a time limit. Contact with a ball costs the player a life.

meta.name: Zolyx
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 12.86 KB

Zolyx is a Qix variant: the player is presented with a white playing field and controls a pixel. Whenever this pixel moves over the playfield, it leaves a line behind - and when the line becomes a closed form, it gets coloured. The goal is to colour 75% of the playfield; everything above gives bonus points for the high score list.
Well, it is not that easy. White pixels fly around the field and touching them result in death; similarly deadly is going backwards on a line. At least the player has two tricks to help himself: he can change the direction of the white pixels by pressing a button (limited) and jail them when drawing a closed line around them. This is possible because the pixels are either confined to the coloured or uncoloured parts. 
After finishing a level a new one starts with three changes: one more white pixel, an extra life for the player and one additional usage of the "direction change" button.

Los mundos están desiertos, con algunas plataformas y peligrosos monstruos llamados Zubs. Zub debe subir por las plataformas, unirlas y seguir saltando entre ellas para alcanzar la cima del nivel y viajar al siguiente planeta. Los Zubs flotan alrededor siguiendo a nuestro héroe, drenando su energía al tocarlo, y deben ser abatidos con la pistola láser.

Another maze, another snake, but still simple fun. This one was released as part of Infogrames' Kid Kit package aimed at young CPC enthusiasts, but it was never published as a separate game. We have several mazes, many dots to eat and one ravenous snake. This time the graphics are very simple, but they are smooth and fast and feature a good screen shaking effect if you run into a dead end or your tail.
